How do I find a doji or a strength in the market

Hello dear traders,

Gladly you get the indicator and a detailed description of how I proceeded here.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

First, create a new chart image in 4H time unit. The beam color should be completely in dark gray, because of the better overview.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

Open the indicator under "General" and replace the number 100 with the number 5.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

Under "level" enters the number 4.8, color red with a thick line.
Under "Color" please enter the color white with size 5.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

If you now enlarge the image view, it should look like my picture. The smaller the white bar, the sooner it is a balance. The red line shows me where to put the white bar, so that it represents a balance for me. If you reduce the number 5, then automatically the number of equilibria decreases, but increases the accuracy of the display.

These are not always perfect Doji, but they are balances. And I finally wanted to find that.

If you enter the numbers 50 and 100 under "level", you can see, the higher the bar is the smaller the shadow of the candle. With the number 100 one finds a pure candle body without wick, which expresses a strength. With this indicator, the candle thickness and the candle weakness on the screen can be displayed.
If you add the momentum indicator in addition, you can draw very interesting conclusions.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

In the 4H chart you can see a strong momentum at point 1, but the candle strength is still low as the bears push the price from high to close. The candle at point 2 is already much stronger, at point 3 creates a balance and uncertainty.

The bearish candle point 4 has momentum and strength, the pullback point 5 also has momentum but very little strength. There is also an Equilibrium, clearly visible in a smaller timeframe. This information suggests that it is likely to continue downhill.

At point 6 comes the confirmation to stay in the market as long as the strength of the bears prevails and the course reaches a decisive equilibrium.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

Unfortunately, since this indicator only has one color, you can simply set the indicator Ticks Separate Volume below it with the setting as shown in the picture. The indicator is to be downloaded in Post 193.

The indicators was created in 2009 by MetaQuotes Software Corp. Thank you for this helpful indicators.

If you have time, you have to work and experiment with it.
I hope I was able to help you just a little bit

Best regards and good luck

--- 帖子 #294 ---
What happens in EURUSD?

Hello dear traders,

There are three phases in a market.

Customers find a product interesting and start buying wildly. The dealer does not follow with the delivery. So the prices rise because everyone wants the product. The demand is thus greater than the supply.

At some point, many customers have the product and it creates a balance. Equilibrium arises because supply is just as strong as demand.

The product is now on the shelf, because most customers have already bought. The dealer lowers the price to get rid of the product. So the supply is bigger than the demand.The dealer lowers the price until a balance is created and then the whole game starts again.

The situation is similar on the stock exchange, where every trader acts as buyer and seller. That makes things a bit more complicated. Even more dramatic is that we compete comparatively as a small dealer against the department store giant Walmart.

In order to anticipate possible price developments, we must look in the price chart for these supply zones and demand zones.
In the monthly chart you can not always easily recognize these supply zones and demand zones. This is due to the time a candle is made. These candles often deceive us traders.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

At the moment point 2 is interesting for us. Where is the course going?

Let's take a look first to point 1. There we see between 1.26 and 1.25 a supply zone, that is, the supply outweighs the demand. This offer zone goes up to 1.207 / 1.199 and to 1.179. Of course, this supply zone then continues to 1.03, however, this supply zone has already been adjusted by a demand zone.
At point 3 we see in the zones 1,179 and 1,207 / 1,199 that the demand is greater than the supply. This zone could be interesting again.
Yesterday, the price has risen sharply and is now entering the crucial resistance zone that has already been run twice. The fact is, if the price hits an offer zone, it will go down. This zone is in my opinion between 1.25 and 1.26. If the price hits a quote zone there, it will go back and possibly try again.
Then the zones 1,207 / 1,199 or 1,179 could become interesting.

If we look at point 4 we see that there is again a strong supply zone there. Thus, one could assume that the price could approach this zone during the year.
Now it's time to keep an eye on this 1.25 to 1.26 zone to possibly take the downtrend. Our problem is the big players, who like to trade without competition up or down. Therefore, there are often wrong signals to cause confusion.
There was a great deal of uncertainty in the Asian area tonight, which is very nice to see here.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

Let's wait until we get started and we might benefit from a supply zone.

I wish you much success

best regards

--- 帖子 #297 ---
The problem of candles

Hello dear traders,

a certain candle says nothing about future price movements, candle formations as well. Let's do a test.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

We take a bullish candle that goes from high to low 50 pip. The candle body is 30 pip, the shadows 10 pip each. I dyed the upper wick in red, as the course went from high to close down when the candle was finished. So for all candles, the top wick should always be red and the bottom wick always green. He is, however, shown neutral because the course first ran from close to high and then again to close. However, looking at the finished candle, the bears had the last word on the top wick and the bull on the bottom wick.

Now there are many ways that the price moves within a certain time frame in the candle. I have two options to choose from.
The question is: In which course (a or b) would they continue to bet on rising prices.
Which probability is greater that the price increases?

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

Let's turn the tables. Again, you have two options to choose from.
The question is: In which course (a or b) would they continue to bet on falling prices.
Which probability is greater that the course falls?

Now there are many theories and answers. The correct answer is: I do not know. Crucial for this is the course before it, but this helps only conditionally.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

The doji is a weak candle because investors are uncertain where to go, the candle next to it symbolizes strength. The Open and Low as well as the Close and High are at an altitude. Here it was agreed that the course goes up. In daily business, one can not exactly analyze every single candle. The density indicator shows this strength very nicely. The range is from 0 to 100. The more this indicator reaches 0 the weaker the candle, the more it gets to 100, the stronger the candle.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

In the 15 M Chart EURUSD you can see 3 beautiful examples. On January 12, 2018, a strong bullish candle is formed. The course is rising. On January 15, 2018, a strong bullish candle will again be created and the price will rise. On January 16, 2018, the bearish candle is not that strong and the price drops a bit.
Unfortunately, this does not always work, but you get clues that should be compared with other circumstances. This is also an auxiliary indicator, as the name suggests, it helps me, but not always.

As a Scalper, I have had very good experiences in the 20 second chart. Try it and make your own experiences.

Guidelines that help me to move forward

1.Without mathematics you can not get on
2.Problems can never be solved with the same mindset that created them.
3.When our calculations fail, we call it coincidence.

I wish you much success

How do I deal with the Equilibrium?

Dear Traders,

Today I want to show you an example of what to look for when you have identified an Equilibrium.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

On 16.01.18 I have identified and drawn an equilibrium at point 1. The course then went up during the night and again formed a POC. When I looked at the course in the morning, you could see that the falling price did not touch my line and started a pullback. After that, the course came to my zone. Acting up here seemed to me to be insecure because we had a supply market. That was later confirmed to me. So I had to wait until the evening. I placed a sell limit order in my zone with a 6 pip stop. The price triggered my sell limit order. I put my take profit on point 4, since I assumed that on my line at point 1 again demand in the market comes. When the price went down 20 pip, I set my stop to zero without risk. I am then out a little earlier, because it was a bit unsafe in the market and I wanted to go to bed.

Of course I could have taken 120 Pip, but with 65 Pip I was very satisfied. Not that you think that's always going so well. There were many cases where my limit order was not triggered, I was stopped or the course came back completely. However, my stops are between 4 to 8 pip. If I'm stopped out I can accept that. When dealing with the Equilibrium, the stops can be a bit smaller, since the range in which the course change takes place can be calculated well.

As Swingscalper I want small stops and the highest possible risk ratio. The longer I am in the market, the less I can estimate where the market is going, and that increases my risk. That's why I'm only in the market for a short time, but I trade with higher contracts. I have tried many systems. The best was and is the Equilibrium. This system comes closest to my optimal way of acting.

At the beginning of my trader career, I have traded only a few seconds or minutes. I took my take profit too early and stayed in it too long when the course went against me. That cost a lot of money. Much back and forth means empty pockets. Therefore, do accurate analysis using the POC, making small stops and then running until an offer or demand zone returns. So you can calculate your trades quite well. This does not always work, but the traders always have a plan B in their pockets.

In the picture you can see very well that it is advantageous to let the market come by rather than run after the market.

If you can identify with this way of doing, take a closer look at this blog.

I'm looking forward to your feedback

--- 帖子 #319 ---
Help to get a feel for the Equilibrium

Dear Traders,

Before we come to an interesting assistance, how to get a better feeling for the Equilibrium, I would like to show you a midnight trade of December 2017 and why I did it. This trade was risky, I realized that later.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

At point 1 and point 2 on 11.Dec 17 one sees very nicely an uncertainty in the market. Shortly thereafter, the course went down. At point 2 I drawn two lines. At point 3 there was another equilibrium, which I ignored for the moment. At the 13.Dec between 13:00 and 14:30 CET point 4 was born. This point was very interesting for me. After an equilibrium, the price went up sharply. There I also drawn two lines. Demand clearly dominated the supply to the point 5. There was a small pullback, then dominated demand back up. Overall, the price went up about 100 pip until again a strong uncertainty prevailed in the market. The third and fourth last candle (top right of the chart) were responsible for my two lines. I do not like such equilibrium because the range is much too big there.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

The price went even further up after a pullback and then suddenly dropped off. At the top I set a line. From this line clearly dominated the offer. The price lines for my buy limit order and my stop were clear, although I thought about putting the stop a little lower. However, I oriented myself to the strong momentum from the top of the 13th of December. When setting the TP, I was also a bit uncertain. The top line was too uncertain for me because the course was strongly rejected there. Added to this was the uncertainty of the slightly larger equilibrium within my two lines. Finally, I decided to put the TP something under the line.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

During the Friday 15.12.2017 the course went up a bit and was pushed down with the US session. Here I was very lucky, because the price closed on Friday evening 8 pip over my buy limit order. I do not like to be in the market over the weekend because potential gaps are unpredictable. Still, I had a high risk of being stopped out by a gap, as the order was in the market. Since I had used a guaranteed stop, I was on the safe side with my loss limit.
Around midnight the 15th of december my buy limit order was triggered.

When the course went through my support line point 5, I pulled the stop on the Zero. So I could not lose any more money. I used to take profits too early, today I just let the course go. Of course, the course also ran back a few times and I was stopped out at 0. But there are always new opportunities and that builds me up in this moment again.

The course went up above the point 5 and the TP was reached. At point 5, the support line could now become the resistance line. Thereafter, the course turned as if by magic in the same zone where previously dominated the offer. The course went back a bit and where did he turn? Exactly on my resistance line, where previously dominated the demand (Figure 1 point 5.) Then it went back up again.

I could have reached 150 pip. That's right, I was very satisfied with 90 Pip. I could have been stopped out, too. That's right, that happened to me many times, but not this time. However, I could have lived well with 7 pip loss plus spread.

The advantage of this approach is that you can set your limit order and then take care of other things. The supply zones and demand zones often show me what could possibly happen.

Expected Profit: 90 pip
Risk: 7 pip plus spread plus guaranteed stop = 9 pip

In this case, the chance risk ratio was 10. That means I could take 10 loss trades for this trade and have had no loss. However, my strategies focus less on the ratio between opportunity and risk, since the opportunities are based on pure assumptions anyway.

Of course, luck must be something on your side, after all, there are enough situations where I overlooked something or the market just did not react as I would have liked. In addition, one often has to wait a long time until the right opportunity arises. But since there are other currency pairs as well, the chances of finding a suitable opportunity are relatively high.

These situations can be trained very well.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

The strategy tester is ideal for this. In Metatrader 4 under "View" you will find this strategy tester. When you open it, you can find all settings in the bottom window. You can work with all the indicators you need. It would be an advantage if you have additional course data available. For me, the 15 M Chart begins in 1971, with optimal price data available only from 1984. In Blog 149 you can find a video on how to get this course data.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

Start the strategy tester and then add all the indicators you need. Set the screen as it suits you best. With the slider (blue circle) you can set the speed with which the candles form. Now you can search for Equilibrium and draw in your zones. Then pull the slider to the right and the course starts to run. Now you can see how the course responds to your zones.

You can play this game in all time levels with all currency pairs, commodities, precious metals or indicia. It is a very efficient training, but only with past courses. So you are also able to train at the weekend on a virtual forex market. If you already know the price history of your currency pair from the past, choose an unknown currency pair for training.

With that helped a lot, I have often watched only the pure running course and found that I have learned so much more than if I had looked at a static chart image. Try it yourself and you'll see that you get better and better over time without having to spend money.

Orders quickly and effectively

Hello dear traders,

In addition to supply, demand and the identification of the Equilibrium, a fast order is often required, with which you can get into the market immediately.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

When I started working with the Metatrader the order opening for a Swingscalper was very cumbersome (point 1). Until all the values had been registered, some time passed. A small relief was the 1 click trade (point 2) in the Metatrader, which did not satisfy me though.
At some point, the brokers started to provide small mini-terminals (point 3). The big problem: The stop could only be placed in the market after the order. As a long-term trader, this is less tragic, for a swing scalper yet.

A few years ago, I discovered the VR steals, a trading panel that was still in its infancy at the time, but already significantly better than the Metatrader variant. In the middle of 2014 I became aware of the 3rd version. That was a breakthrough for fast trading.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

The screen remains very clear and efficient. The order execution is very fast, although this depends mostly on the broker. When you place an order, all relevant data that you have previously determined are included directly. This saves a lot of time. Stop and take profit lines can easily be moved at any time.
A little thing on the edge. There are brokers that allow scalping, but the smallest stop is 4 pip. If I place a limit order, it must be at least 4 pip away from the current price, otherwise it can not be placed. That annoyed me then, because I think a stop should be used individually. In the same way, you should be able to set a limit of 0.1 pip from the price if you want to.

Of course, this is possible in the futures market, which is more difficult in the CFD market, but there are brokers there too who grant this opportunity.
In certain situations, I find guaranteed stops very important, an example was the crash in EURCHF 2013th. Today, you would risk a maximum of your account, but at least no further money to pay. Therefore, make sure that you can decide when a guaranteed stop is important and when you can do without it. Since there are many brokers, you have enough choice.

Back to the Trade Panel VR Steals

I have seen that a high impact member (Voldemar227) has already presented this indicator in detail. The indicator was developed by him, and he has done a lot of work to introduce this great idea. That's why I want to refer to his page. There you get all the information. Thanks again to Voldemar227.

https://www.forexfactory.com/showthread.php?t=584980

There is also a video, unfortunately only in Russian, but that explains itself almost by itself.
Just drop by and work with this trading panel if you like it.

Where does the EURUSD path lead us?

Dear Traders,

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

If we look at 2014 in the 4-H chart at point 1, supply dominates demand. This dominance goes with small pullbacks up to point 4. At point 4, there is then a strong uncertainty and the price continues to fall.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

In 2018, it looks like this. At the moment the price fluctuates around the line 2. If the course manages to get over the line 1 sustainably and then recognizes the line 1 as a resistance, the bull is up to 1,288 little in the way.
If the course crosses line 3 and recognizes it as resistance, the course could run to line 4. Between point 3 and point 4, we expect a strong demand market.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

At the beginning of 2010 there was a demand market from point 1 to point 4. In the short term the price went from point 1 to point 2. Then the supply dominated the demand and the price went to point 3. This point happened to be our current resistance point A.
In May 2012 there was again a demand market from point 5 to point 7, whereby the first move went to point 6. Demand dominates supply in this zone.
From point 7 to point 8, supply dominated again and prices fell. After two pullbacks, the market went down. At the end of 2016, when everyone thought that parity was not far away, buyers came to the market and bought everything.
Now we stand at the point A. The range 1.288 on the top and 1.162 on the bottom. Looking at demand and supply, it should not go above or below this zone in the medium term.

If the price is going up now, it will end at 1.288. After that, the supply market will start the range between A and B. If the course now runs to point B, the demand comes at point B. That would be enough to bring the course to the 1.288. There will be a pullback, which should not be so strong.
Then the way to the 1,399 would be free, and there will be some pullbacks along the way.
This is pure speculation and my opinion due to the situation of supply or demand. However, there are endless possibilities that will come in between and therefore it will certainly be different.

Now we are back to the point. First of all, I need a rough goal. Then I set myself intermediate goals and at the very end I go into the fine structure.
The fine structure is the smaller time units with the task of identifying and implementing the right equilibrium.
And that's where we're going to start this year to make it easier to reach one goal or another.

I wish you much success

Best regards

How the US Dollar Index continues to help us

Dear Traders,

The US Dollar Index (USDX) represents the ratio of the following currency basket to the US dollar:
Euro 57.6%, Japanese yen 13.6%, British pound 11.9%, Canadian dollar 9.1%, Swedish krona 4.2% and the Swiss franc 3.6%
This can be used to read the strength or weakness of the US dollar. A rising index means that the US dollar is strengthening against the currencies in the basket of currencies, while a falling index is depreciating.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

In order for you to be able to load the US Dollar Index into your MetaTrader, your broker must provide it to you. Not every broker offers this service.
Under "View" and "Market Overview" you have to select "Show all" and see if the US Dollar Index is available.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

If you compare the US Dollar Index with the EURUSD, you will believe at first sight that the price is exactly the same. The opposite is the case. Basically, the courses are similar, which is inevitably clear, but the differences are clearly visible. What has always bothered me is that the US Dollar Index is almost mirrored to the EURUSD. Being a visual person, I wanted to put the US Dollar Index in the same direction as the EURUSD.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

I finally succeeded with the iMirror indicator. Unfortunately, I can not figure out who developed this indicator, but it does help to implement that idea. At the end I post this auxiliary indicator. With this help, the US Dollar Index can move in the same way as the EURUSD. Where I drew the two circles would have been a nice confirmation for me that the course goes down. Since the price is only in a sideways range, that was only 16 pip, but at least.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

As a rule I work in the 1H chart with the US Dollar Index and can work there with supply, demand and balance as described in our blog. Sometimes the US Dollar Index determines where to go and sometimes the EURUSD. I can use this index very well as a confirmation, but it is not the holy grail.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

Unfortunately, I can not consider the price display because the chart image is mirrored. Neither can I use the Momentum Indicator, which gives me the strongest momentum in the course. Here, the Sensity indicator helps me find the strongest and weakest candles in the market.
Just when the EURUSD hit an important resistance line, the US Dollar Index has usually provided me with very good information.

This is a nice help, for me still supply, demand and balance decide on success and failure.

I wish you a nice day

best regards

Trading workplace with 5 screens under $ 2,000

Dear Traders,

Anyone who wants to earn money on the stock market in the long term must invest. But you do not need to invest $ 10,000 at the beginning. If I invest, the price / performance ratio should be right. At the beginning I searched the internet for what i needed. I was scared how expensive such equipment was. If you want to become a full-time trader and have already gained experience in the marketplace, you should be comfortable at work and be able to work efficiently.
The question what you need is not so easy to answer, because everyone sees differently. Personally, I started with 4 screens and now there are 7 screens. That has been enough, but I will now upgrade something. Since I preferred to invest my money for the trades in the beginning, I had to come up with a solution.

Today I would like to introduce an idea, how you can put together a trading workplace with 5 screens under $ 2,400, or with 10 screens under $ 4,500. For the beginner certainly enough 2 screens, but professionals who want to optimize their trading station, could save a lot here.

Let's start with the computer. A laptop is enough for a start. Although Sony laptops are no longer manufactured, these are among my favorites. They are sturdy and because they are not built anymore, you get a Vaio laptop 17 inches with an i7 processor needed for $ 500. Make sure the Sony has a high end CPU with a Pass Mark value of at least 7,000. Here you can compare your CPU.

https://www.cpubenchmark.net/high_end_cpus.html

The RAM should be at least 8 GB and replace the 1 TB HDD hard drive with a Samsung 500GB SSD 850 EVO.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

The advantage of my Windows 10 was up within 20 seconds and shut down in 5 seconds. Performance is also important, there are up to 6 different Metatraders running on my computer and up to 46 auxiliary indicators (Post 246) on my dashboard. This requires enormous power, which you certainly do not need in the beginning. To increase the access times you should set the rapid mode of Samsung, which brings the biggest improvement.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

My access times are much better than before, which makes trading a lot easier. If you have an SSD in use, you can check the performance with the AS SSD benchmark, if you work with an HDD you need the program CrystalDiskMark. You can download the programs for free and check your computer. If you did the test, do not be fooled, at the beginning I had only 1,100 points. You can optimize everything.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

As a monitor, I recommend the LG 32mp58hq-p monitor for about $ 250. He is 32 inches, a good resolution of 1,920 x 1,080 pixels has a decent access time and brightness. Your office chair should have a lumbar support and guarantee you a neat hold. It does not have to be a Recaro chair at the beginning. Just enter gamer chair on Ebay. An external graphics card saves the resources of your laptop. Here I recommend Digitus USB 3.0 adapter apiece for $ 75. A wall bracket should be adjustable on all sides costs about $ 50 each. An active USB distributor costs $ 20. Still a few USB cables, HDMI cables and a network cable for a total of $ 40.

Altogether we are for the laptop with SSD, 4 monitors 32 inches, 4 external graphics cards, office chair, wall mounts and accessories at about $ 2,400.
This will cost 10 screens 8 x 32 inches plus 2 laptops with all accessories around $ 4,500.

If you look around a bit, you can certainly save even more. With the Sony Vaio you can already drive 2 additional screens, so you would need only 2 external graphics cards in the beginning. If you negotiate well, you can buy a decent trading workplace for less than $ 2,000.

I have two different internet providers with 100 Mbit. One provider via cable, the other via the wireless network. I get the best speed over a network cable and the wireless network is my last resort. If the power goes out, I do not need an external power supply with the laptop, but then the Internet is off. Then I still have my cell phone with which I can close the position in an emergency.

In addition, I recommend a CO2 meter, please read Post 131

Light, oxygen, a good desk as adjustable as possible, so that you can sometimes stand are a basis for good work. I will rebuild my trading room this year to enjoy more comfort. I think if you spend many hours in a room, you should feel good. Then you can overcome losses much easier and enjoy the profit twice.
I hope you had some ideas and I look forward to your feedback.

A beautiful and successful day.

Best regards

EUR ECB Monetary Policy Meeting

Today at 13:30 CET it started, the course plunged 16 pip down, 37 pip up and then again 20 pip down. And within a minute. Then it went 22 Pip down and 22 Pip up in one hour. After an hour we were back where we started. So and what did the whole thing. At least a little fun. When I saw that the price was going down, I put a buy stop at the Daily Open and was lucky this time. You have to pay attention to these fake breakouts often have a range of 15-17 Pip until it goes back massively in the other direction.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

To trade in such situations is like going to the casino. So this meeting was a decisive factor for the EURUSD, but I see it completely different. Although the course has moved, once down and once up, but after an hour were back where we started. So, in fact, nothing happened.

After that, nothing happened, because the course was anyway in the downward trend to form a pullback. And that is exactly what happened. I do not mean to say that the meetings have no impact on the traders and thus on the courses, but the meeting today has changed little about the overall situation. Maybe the pullback upwards may have been accelerated a bit, but that's about it.

That's why I usually keep out of such situations. Today I had expected to be stopped out with 4 pip and I had a guaranteed stop. But it had nothing to do with Trading.

It is always fun in the evening to find out at NTV, why the DAX or EURUSD has risen or fallen. It does not matter what the news is about the ticker. The market is moving because people and computers are pushing the BUY or SELL button. And why are you pushing to BUY or SELL? Because you have an opinion. And this opinion often has nothing to do with the economic data.

As I said, that is my personal opinion and I also respect any other opinion.

Of course, the economy in each country is important, but not for me. For me, how investors respond to the news is far more important.
And it was the same today. After waiting an hour, the pullback could continue today. I had expected anyway that the pullback only runs until 1.2348 and then continues its downward trend, but I can be wrong too.

That's why my recommendation, do not listen to the news, but look how the investors react to it. If there is a storm at sea you should stay in the harbor with a small sailing boat. When a fresh breeze blows then sailing is fun.

I wish you a nice evening.

best regards

Equilibrium in the monthly chart

Dear Traders,

In order to find out what will happen in the EURUSD over the next few months, we need to look more closely at the Equilibrium.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

At point 1 we can see how the bullish price came off strongly from a pullback and formed a small equilibrium. After that, the price continued to rise sharply.

If you follow this line, you can see how the big pullback has responded to point 3. Between 2014 and 2017, the monthly price has reacted three more times to the line. Equilibrium is created at point 2 and it can be observed that the course reacts five times to this and finally forms an equilibrium again at point 6. This line now acts as a resistance. Point 3 is not very clear to me, because after a small equilibrium a large equilibrium was formed. However, this line could be a big resistance when the price of 1.255 arrives in this zone. Point 4 is a clear zone, but it is unclear whether as resistance or support. If the point 6 holds as a resistance and the course then starts up from 1.179, I would be more inclined to view the line 4 as a support line. Attached Image (click to enlarge)

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

Most of the price movements are not fakes, they are the result of sell order and buy order. Attached Image (click to enlarge)

Losses are part of the business, as are profits. That's why I'm not interested in that. I never try to recoup my losses on the same day. Very important, the next day I start at zero and not in the minus. New day new game.

--- 帖子 #374 ---
Breakout without annoying passengers

Dear Traders,

The forex market today is much harder to trade than it was many years ago. The reason is because of how the traders are oriented. I'm not talking about the private trades that make up only a fraction of the market, but the commercials and non-commercials. Commercials are often producing or manufacturing companies, which because of their dependency secures themselves from commodity prices on the futures market. (Hedgers)

Non-commercials are typically performance-oriented institutional traders or solvent private investors who meet the minimum reporting requirements.
Particularly aggressive are the very short-term oriented high-frequency traders on which I have already written a report. (Post 205 & 237)
These high-frequency traders already account for more than 50% of the turnover on some exchanges on certain days. These traders are very short-term invested and cut with all tricks, small pieces out of the big cake. These high frequency scalper work with complex algorithms to analyze different markets and execute orders depending on market conditions. Their technology and their programs are almost unrivaled.

These traders often provide for the impossible movements in the market, where you ask yourself as a private trader: Where is the trend actually going?

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

We write Oct 17, after a 200 pip uptrend comes a downtrend that will grow to be 150 pip. The course goes down to a nice 70 pip. Suddenly the price goes up 70 pip within minutes and then the downtrend continues as if nothing had ever happened. Who is pushing for buy in a falling market please? Answer: He has enough money. Why does one do it? First, because nobody expects it. Second, so that you get a better purchase price. Third, to stop most traders, because competition slows down the prices.

If I want to trade high as a big player, you need to have as little as possible on board. Why? The answer is simple, if the price goes up a lot, many traders want to get out quickly to make a profit. So to get out I have to sell my trade. When many traders sell, the price of the upside should not continue. This means that the fewer traders are pulled up, the higher my price.

So I have to confuse the traders, I have to let them believe that the course is going in a completely different direction. Then I'm up in the market alone.We are fooled every day. The only way to protect yourself is to watch the Equilibrium in the market. Of course I would have been stopped in the situation, but my stop would have closed at 5 pip. I could have gotten over that. But there are many traders working with larger stops. The interesting thing about the Equilibrium would have been in this situation, that one gets an idea of how far this move could go and would go down exactly in the zone of Equlibrium.
Nevertheless, one could have foreseen it, or could have guessed better.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

I have drawn a yellow line where the price has shot up strongly. Let's look back 3 days. You see how the course goes to point 4. Question: At what point 1,2 or 3 did demand dominate supply?

Correct answer: At point 3. From point 3, the course has almost gone through to point 4. Before, he has always run back. This line was thus a sign that the course there can again become bullish. No one could have guessed that the course became so strong.

This is not magic but simply supply, demand and balance. Every market is dependent on that. The big players may have much more money than I'll ever own, but these traders leave their mark on the market, and if you know how to do that, you can maximize your profits and limit losses. That's the advantage of the little ones, no one sees me in the market and fewest big players know that I often know what they are up to. If the big players are pursuing a strategy, they look in the orderbook where all the traders are positioned. They also find out where the buy or sell order is and so can do their thing to the detriment of many traders.

Actually, this is an exciting thing if you know who you are dealing with. I do not want to suggest that I always have the clarity, but with each passing day, my feeling and my experience is getting better and better. My advantage as a small trader is that no one perceives me. But I can see the tracks of the big players and just have to interpret them correctly. But this is easier than if there are no traces that you could interpret.

In the present time, it is not the big ones who eat the little ones, but the fast ones the slow ones.

And that is exactly our chance, which we should use.

I wish you a great day

best regards

According to many opinions in the Forex market, only 5% of all traders should trade successfully. If this number is correct this means: 95% of all traders are wrong. The chance that you yourself belong to the 95% is relatively larger than that counts to the 5% of good traders. But now to belong to the 5% in the future, there would be an easy way. If you want to trade the GBP / JPY now, you would have to hear the opinion of 100 traders on this currency pair. 90% say the price goes up and 10% say the price falls.

Theoretically, one would have to sell now, since here the probability is greater to win. It is only stupid if the 100 traders are among the 5% who trade successfully. But the likelihood seems very low in this case.

One thing I can say with certainty:

If I hear from the taxi driver buying a particular stock because it's going off really well, I have to go home quickly and sell that stock as fast as possible.

And maybe that's our big problem, we trust others more than ourselves. So it's time to build one's faith in oneself. --- 帖子 #396 ---
Concrete guidance of supply and demand

Dear Traders,

There are 3 different states in the market.
1. Offer outweighs the demand = price drops
2. Demand outweighs the offer = price rises
3. Offer and demand are balanced

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

Your see that 5 M chart in EURUSD. In the last 6 hours, the price has risen and after fallen again. What will happen next? Where is the course going? Where will he change the trend direction? Where is the best way to get started? How can you make over 100 pip in the next 6 hours? How do I keep my risk as small as possible? How can I optimize my profits?

I would like to answer these questions in this post.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

Let's start analyzing the chart. The first question is where does offer dominate demand and where does demand dominate offer?
Point 1: Equilibrium is created, the course falls short and then rises. From the second line, where the long bullish candle starts, demand dominates offer. That means there are more buyers than sellers in this area.

The course runs to point 2 and a larger equilibrium arises. In principle, this are two equilibrium. In the first lower circle you can see a balance, then the course increases. After that, a balance is created and the price rises more. The course runs to point 3. There is a balance again, then a small reset and a small move to the top. At point 4 there is again an equilibrium, which is difficult to recognize due to the time unit. Then the course falls to point 5. Again, an equilibrium is formed. The course continues to point 6. There we stand now. The question is, what's next?

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

We have identified the most important equilibrium and now draw a line above and below the equilibrium. Here again we see in the overview where offer or demand dominates. The course has penetrated from above into our demand zone. That means here wait buyers to push up the price. We have marked two demand zones here. For me, the lower zone (upper line) would be the first choice, because from there the demand has started.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

The price rises a little and falls right into the lower demand zone. The buyers jump up and bring the course up to the offer zone. This pushes the course down again, because not all sellers were satisfied. The price falls into the upper demand zone, the buyers absorb the sellers and the price rises. As soon as it comes back into the offer zone the price goes back again briefly, but now all sell orders are out of the market and the price can rise unhindered. There are two offer zones up there, the course is in the first zone. What is happening next?

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

The course is falling back. How far does he fall back? Until he comes to the zone where there are no sellers anymore. You remember that buyers in this zone had absorbed all sell orders. What will happen if you know that there are no sellers left in the zone?

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

Just right, the course has to rise. How far does the course go? Up to the zone where offer dominates demand. That's where the course is now. What happens when you know that this zone is a strong offer zone? The course must fall. How far will the course fall? Answer: Until he comes back into a strong demand zone. And where is our strongest demand zone?

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

Exactly right, where it all started. In between, the course has put down a small pullback again, just take a look at where the pullback took place. Critics will say: That's all coincidence. I say: this has to do with offer, demand and balance and that is no coincidence but these are the laws of the market.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

I have drawn the zones once in rose for a better overview. Altogether that was 4 trades. There are 3 small lines. The red is the stop, the green the start order and the blue the take profit. You can work with limit orders or manual orders. I usually prefer the limit order because it gives me better market access.

The first trade brought in 26.6 pip at 4 pip risk = risk reward ratio 1: 7
The long trade brought 15.8 pip at 3 pip risk = risk reward ratio 1: 5
The third trade brought 21.5 pip at 5 pip risk = risk reward ratio 1: 4
The fourth trade brought 46.4 pip at 3 pip risk = risk reward ratio 1:15

As the fourth Tarde went down, it could be assumed that he would start another pullback in Zone 1. I would have let the trade go anyway. If a candle had formed over my zone 2, I would have dropped out. Altogether that would have been 110 pip with a risk of 15 pip. A risk reward ratio of 1: 7 in 6 hours.
The interesting thing is that I would have held the fourth trade even longer. Why?

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

The answer can be found in the overview in the 4 H chart. Just look at the zones according to the criteria mentioned above. From Zone 1, demand dominated offer. After that the course fell back and broke through this zone. He formed an equilibrium and from the point 2 dominated the offer again. Then the course came back up. From point 3 the demand dominated. Our zone was still fresh, which means the course has not yet arrived in our zone. In the big circle where the blue arrow is in the 5 minute chart is our last course. That's why I would have kept the course going. Although there was a stronger pullback later on the way down, however, this pullback came back exactly into our designated zone. You can take a closer look at it yourself. What do you think is going to happen to the course when it comes to the bottom zone at the right green arrow?

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

It will rise because the demand zone is very strong. The course has risen sharply, then Friday was evening and closing time. On Sunday evening, a big gap of 180 pip. Where did the Gap go? Up to our Zone 5. Of course, nobody could have foreseen that. But you could have taken the pullback well to point 6.
By the way, look at point 2, and then at point 1 and point 0. What is noticeable? Equilibrium then high course, back through our zone 1 to point 3. Then new Equilibrium and further down. That means we could already guess where a strong offer zone prevails.

Is that still a coincidence? Maybe, but I use these coincidences regularly to live from it. How many indicators did we use here? How many messages have we heard in this time? Indicators and news are important, but more important are the price charts and your personally marked zones.

Start by the way, draw in these zones. Look at when demand dominates the offer and look for the Equilibrium. Look at when the offer dominates the demand and look for the Equilibrium. Then record these lines and observe how the course behaves there.
I'm sure you'll get on with it.

I wish you could use this information effectively for you.

I wish you a successful week.

Best regards

The supreme discipline: what you are good at, so explaining that someone else will succeed.

The big challenge lies in communication. There are different cultures, languages and, unfortunately, many vanities that prevent some people from succeeding. It is often about being better than the other.

But only the continuous application leads to success. And that is exactly the challenge.

Earlier, when I started trading, I thought that I needed to find just the right indicator to succeed. So I went in search. Every time I installed a new indicator in the chart I was motivated and convinced. But after that time, I realized that it was not the right one and kept searching. Until I realized that I have not seen the forest for the trees. The best indicator is the pure price chart. The problem is that it is incredibly difficult and time-consuming to understand and interpret this pure price discourse. The stock market is not easy and you have to be aware, if you want to act successfully, that the effort to learn this profession is enormously high. Indicators help translate the price charts into a language that we traders understand more easily. Therefore, I also use indicators, but no standard indicators such as MACD, RSI or Stochasic.

Another challenge is long-term forecasting. When I predict the supply, demand and balance as a trader, this forecast is often changed by a new trend. Therefore, forecasts should be viewed with caution.

Your own prognosis should be your recipe for success in the long term. Therefore, we must be willing to learn more than others. My contributions here should not help to derive a trade, but to understand the principle of supply, demand and balance. If I get a tip from FF and handle it, maybe I'll win once. But maybe I do not understand why I won. The key is to understand why you lose and why you win. And that works only if I deal with the system correctly.

Point landing without sight

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

Dear Traders,

Flying with a plane is 100 times safer than driving and even 3,000 times safer than riding a motorcycle. According to the US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), the chance of surviving a plane crash is 90 percent. The most dangerous phases of a flight are 20% at take-off, 30% during flight and 50% at landing.

A trade has a similar structure: 1. Start of the trade, 2. Trade in progress and 3. Landing of the trade.

If we assume that when starting a trade you have a 50% chance that you are right, you can do relatively little wrong here. If the trade is running, the error rate is also lower. The challenge is closing the trade. Here decides the amount of the profit or the loss.

The challenge we all have is that nobody knows where the course is going. We can guess, maybe improve the odds in our favor, but we don´t know.
Trading in principle is like flying without sight. But despite fog, blizzard darkness and poor visibility, the pilots make the almost impossible and land the A380 with 500 tons safely on the runway.

But how is that possible? Instrument landing system, ILS is the magic word that helps pilots land. Two beacons that set the course and altitude for landing are processed by a special ILS receiver and displayed in the cockpit. This allows pilots to determine during landing that they are on the right track and correct possible deviations immediately.

Such an ILS system is also available for trading. It is the price chart and our indicators that we use to act.
Any experienced trader swears by his system, and as long as he makes more profit than loss, he's right. Since there are many traders, there are also many different systems that are more or less successful. What is good for the one trader does not have to be good for the other.

A daytrader goes short and a scalper goes long, both can be right. Both had a profit, although at the same time they acted in different directions.
The secret of being successful is finding and implementing the right system for your personality. That's why it's important to find out what kind of trader you are. Then it's about the system and then about money management. All this must be coordinated to be successful in the long term.

I've tried different systems over many years, and I've come to the conclusion that supply, demand and balance are the factors that best support my style of action and produce more profit than loss. It does not necessarily mean that my system is the best in the world. It just means that for me it is the best in the world. And that means nothing else than that I have found my system for me. But that took a few years. In retrospect, every trader wishes that he could have discovered his system today earlier. But that's always a matter of time. If you spend more than a year on the stock exchange, the odds of being successful are very high. Unfortunately, there is no guarantee for that.

So first, look at what type of trader you are, then find your matching system and organize your money management. After that you are light years ahead of the others. If you are not as successful as you wish, there is a nice sentence:

Every day you have the chance to start over.

I wish you success on this journey

Best regards

--- 帖子 #414 ---
Cost Average Effect

In the case of the cost-averaging effect, an investor buys more shares for a constant amount while falling prices and less shares when prices rise.

With a longer-term fund savings plan, the investor thus achieves a better average price for his fund units than with a single purchase. Even the regular investment in fixed shares can be a disadvantage. The effect of the cost-averaging effect is greater the longer the fund savings plan runs and the more volatile the price of the funds invested in.

Let's make a simple example:

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

Investor A loves tomatoes and therefore buys 1lb of tomatoes every quarter. In the spring the lb = 1 $, in the summer a offer market lb = 0.5 $, in the autumn the lb = 1 $ and in the winter a demand market lb = 2 $. Investor A pays for 4lb tomatoes = $ 4.5.

Investor B also loves tomatoes but always buys for a fixed amount of $ 1. Investor B pays only $ 4 for 4.5lb.

Investor A has paid a price of 1.125 / lb
Investor B has paid a price of 0.889 / lb

Advantage over 20%

Let's take a look at this in the area of investment funds: (costs were not taken into account)

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

Investor A always buys 2 fund shares over one year. The fund shares are worth $ 2,400 after one year. He paid $ 1,500 for this.

Investor B always buys shares for $ 100 12 times a year. The fund shares are worth $ 2,400 after one year. He paid $ 1,200 for it.

Investor A has paid a price of $ 62.5 / unit

Investor B has paid a price of $ 50 / Unit

Advantage over 20%

This clearly shows that for a fixed, even contribution, you have a clear advantage over investing in fixed shares of a stock or fund.

Conclusion: Never get into a fund with all your money. Prices change, over a longer period of time you can achieve better purchase prices through the cost-averaging effect. Timing is always a bit of a hit and miss - with Cost Average you get this component under control as well. In the case of a constantly rising share price performance, you perform a little worse than the actual price increase.

Once you realize the implications of Compound Interest, Loss and Cost Average, all you have to do is look for the right strategy to get started.

A lovely evening

International currency trading is currently averaging $ 5.1 trillion per day. Foreign exchange is now regarded as a separate asset class, as the market has grown enormously in recent years. He is distinguished between:

Majors: currency pairs that are traded the most

Minors: currency pairs that have a lower trading volume; usually without US dollars

Exotics: rarely traded currency pairs; often consisting of a major currency and a currency from an emerging or developing country.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

These 6 first currency pairs make up about 2/3 of the total revenue. The EURUSD ranks first with 23-25%, almost the same amount of revenue as the remaining currency pairs combined. That's why I posted a lot in the EURUSD.

The currency pairs that are the most traded are interesting because there is a certain uniformity in volatility. Take an exotic currency pair as an example. Often there is little movement and suddenly the course jumps up or down by 60 pip.

I always recommend concentration on the essentials. The first 10 major currency pairs account for 75% of sales. I think that should be interesting.

If you trade a currency pair, you have to be aware of the respective market economy and its consequences.

In addition one should pay attention to correlations of the traded currency pairs. If you have a long position in EUR / USD, and you also open a long position in GBP / USD, you increase your potential risk as the EUR / USD and GBP / USD tend to go in a similar direction.

Are women the better traders?

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

In recent years there have been some articles comparing female traders with male traders. It turned out that women achieved higher returns than their male competitors. There were also several studies that clearly proved this. To begin with, the differences do not seem to be as strong as the press published a few years ago. Nevertheless, there were differences and we will deal with them today.

Basically it should be mentioned that here the exception confirms the rule. There are many women and men who act in the same way in the trade, as determined in the studies. These should not now question the basis of the article. Men in the study were more willing to take risks than women, which meant that men spent more time trades, took more risks, kept fewer rules, and paid significantly more. Women traded with less risk and sold fewer trades. That led to a clear advantage for the women.

Less risk and less trading means fewer fees. But that women are basically the better traders is a myth.

By the way, seniors in the study did as well as the women, showing that the older men get smarter. I believe that both women and men have their strengths in stock market trading, it is about combining these strengths to achieve an advantage for both sexes. Men are more reckless than women, which means men overestimate their skills and underestimate the risk. Women underestimate their skills and overestimate the risk. Both properties can thus be an advantage as well as a disadvantage.

Women tend to retire after periods of loss, while men want to show it to the market faster with revenge trades to get their lost money back.

In normal stock market phases, the woman's strategy is clearly in the advantage. Less trades, less risk and less fees. In strong stock market phases, the strategy of the men is clearly in the advantage.

It is therefore about the respective different strategy of the sexes at the right time to use. In sideways phases, rather a little more restrained and act in the trend phases really accelerate. With markets moving sideways 70% of the time, you have to adapt to the situation.

First tip: In order to analyze the market and to assess the direction of the trend correctly, one should always ask oneself whether the supply currently dominates the demand or the demand dominates the supply.

Second tip: focus on the essentials. Focus on the main currency pairs and become a professional. If you trade too many currency pairs, you can quickly get bogged down.

Third tip: If there is no or very high volatility, they just stay outside. You do not always have to act.

Fourth tip: Listen to your partner from time to time, no matter if male or female.

Conclusion: It does not matter if you are a woman or a man, if you internalize the good qualities of the other sex, it can lead to a very profitable profit situation.

best regards

How daily our senses are confused

Dear Traders,

we have plotted all our lines, supports, resistance, Fibonacci or other aids and located a possible entryway. Now we look at the chart image and watch the current candle. Already here we commit the first mistake. The movement of the candles is often in inverse proportion to the actual later course.

This is often because a down-going candle is stopped by the bullish buyers in their downward movement and then finally pushed upwards. The question is: is it a pullback or a trend reversal?

If it's a pullback, how far is it going? When does a pullback turn into a trend? In principle, we have a 50% chance of being right. With the right money management, this opportunity will be enough, unless we realize our profits too early and rise too late in loss phases. Our course now comes to a specific point that we have previously set. Now we are watching the price trend. And that's exactly where most mistakes happen. It is quite clear that a pullback arises because suddenly there are sellers in a buyer's market or suddenly there are buyers in a sellers' market. The appearance of these opposite buyers or sellers is always different and can not be generalized.

And that's exactly where our senses deceive us. The reason for this lies in our belief in where the course should go next. If the movement of the candle supports our conviction we go into the trade. That goes awry in most cases. In the case of professionals, this case occurs less often because you have a lot of experience and have seen this process a few hundred times. By this we realize, it is not enough to see a chart image, it is much more important to see how it is created. Therefore, especially beginners should deal with the strategy tester at the weekend, because there you can watch the running candles well to learn.

Now let's look at a classic example:

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

The track has gone up with strong momentum, has made a short pullback and is still on the upside. Now everyone will say you should not buy on top. Where is in the chart above and where is below? Which price is expensive which price is cheap?

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

3 times the course has tried to get through the upper zone, three times he has failed. The question is he trying a fourth time or is he failing?

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

The price has gone down. Where is the journey going next? The momentum down is stronger.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

The course has broken the upper resistance. That would be a good reason that the price could go up further?

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

The question is only when and if he ever goes further up.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

A weak share price, rather a big equilibrium in the 4 H chart. He seems to come to a resistance, so maybe down.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

Well convincing does not look that way.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

Maybe further up

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

The pullback is over, now the resistance line would have to be broken upwards.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

Well did not work out, maybe I should give the bear a chance now. Unfortunately, this trade would have gone awry.

Worse is the whole thing if you still watching the running candles. Therefore, try to hide the current candle before entering the trade. Whether you generate better entrances you will see if you try it. Maybe then your senses will not be so confused and you will have more success. Effectively you can judge only after a detailed documentation.

When trading applies the motto: Who has made a mistake and not corrected, commits a second.

Of course, my tip could bring you no value, but it could also bring a small breakthrough. No matter how it ends, whoever stops improving has stopped being good.

I wish you a lot of success,

best regards

The same time, different candles

Dear Traders,

Today I would like to show you once the big differences in the candle formation in the 4 H chart. The following example shows the candle construction at IG Markets, Forex Factory, as well as Activtrades MT4.1 and Activtrades MT4.2 (data update via MetaQuotes).

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

In advance, all providers show from their side a correct candle image. Nevertheless, there are serious differences. Take a look at the course within the blue squares. Now the confusion is great. Of course it would be optimal if all traders could see the same candles, but this is impossible due to the different brokers and different course positions. This means that the candle formation is different for many traders.

Here is already the first evidence that candle formations can not work in my eyes. Now imagine some indicators that each trader has built into his chart.

If you squeeze your eyes and look at the four chart images, the picture is about right. Nevertheless, it makes a big difference when you pay attention to the candles to make a trade.

The smaller the time units become, the smaller the difference, but there are clear differences here as well. The big problem is that my chart picture suggests to me a truth that is not really a truth. Basically, it is known that the price position in the futures market deviates significantly from the prices of the CFD market. But that should not be a reason to say goodbye to the CFD market. One solution would be to deal with the futures market in the long term. However, you should bring at least $ 25,000 capital for this. This is hard for many part-time traders.

If many traders see different candle formations on their screen, one should ask themselves if resistance lines, support lines and indicators work as expected. Especially with chart analysis, I see a certain challenge there. In principle, the course position is correct for all four chart patterns shown, the display varies only slightly.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

Let's take a look at the charts in which we can see a clear equilibrium. In picture 1-3 we can clearly define the equilibrium, in picture 4 it will be a bit more difficult but still possible.

Solution:

Always assume that your chart image is not 100% true. Look for the Equilibrium, no matter what the chart looks like, so I think you have the best chance of finding a trend reversal.

I wish you a nice and successful day.

Exercise on Equilibrium

Hello dear traders,

Identifying the Equilibrium is not difficult, but finding the right Equilibrium is a challenge. It's handy if you sometimes get some lines from me, but then you can not understand why I have drawn these lines. The goal should be to find and draw these important resistance lines yourself. Practice makes perfect, with this motto I would like to motivate you to take part in an exercise today. You can do the exercise in advance at any time. The learning success is huge, you will experience it.

Open a new chart in the 1 hours time unit and reduce this chart until you see the 1 hour candles from the beginning of the year 2018 until today. The color of the complete candles should be DimGrey. Upload the Indicator Momentum Candles and set the following values: candle pipvalue: 13, hilow pipvalue: 13, color: red and lime, width: 2 You can upload the indicator at the end of my article.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

Your chart should now look like this, of course without the resistance lines shown. You do not need the numbers at the end of the candles.
Now look at where a trend reversal takes place and then draw a red bar to the left. Now you have to analyze where the equilibrium is, which is responsible for the trend reversal. This is not always easy in the 4H chart, but start with this exercise.

The blue arrows I have drawn indicate that the Equilibrium come from the past (2014 and 2012). You do not have to pay attention to them first.
Once you've plotted all the trend turns, you can go look for them in 2014 and 2012 to find the equilibrium that was responsible for reversing the trend by the end of January 2018. (Where I drew the blue arrows) Then go back to the year 2018 and look at your drawn resistance lines in the 30M chart, 15M chart or 5M chart. Now you can set your resistance lines more precisely.

That's why I get off to a good start with a 4-7 pip stop. If I make an equilibrium where my stop would be greater than 10, I may wait until the trend reversal is completed and then looking for a way to get started. When you work with the Equilibrium, you can practically pick the best and most profitable trades with the lowest risk. But sometimes that means waiting. But there is also the possibility to observe all major currency pairs and only enter when it is worthwhile.

Start with your training, you will see that you are getting better and better at understanding how the market works. The principle of supply and demand always works the same. You need some time for that, but it's worth it. After a while, you will trade up when everyone thinks it is going down. And the market will prove you right.

I train this every day in all currency pairs. Of course, I do not meet all of Equilibrium because of the different types of candles that different brokers make. For this I wrote a post yesterday. But the hit rate is enormous and very efficient.

I wish you a lot of fun in the training and then a lot of success in the Pip gather.

best regards

--- 帖子 #460 ---
You only learn about pain or insight

Hello dear traders,

Trading is a business, you win or you lose. The fundamental question is, how do you make it that the profits are higher than the losses? There is no unit type and no recipe for success.

To be successful in the trading business, I have to know myself 100%. Now you will laugh and think that you know yourself best, because after all, you experience yourself every day. Unfortunately, we are mistaken in this assumption. How often are we alerted by others to our bad habits that we no longer notice.

How should we correct mistakes in the trading business that we may not even notice? Solution: We simply copy the successful traders. But if two do the same, it is far from the same. Successful people differ from less successful people by the match of personality structure and behavior. Less successful people imitate other people and do things that are different from their nature and personality. So it's important to know your personal traits and act accordingly!

The solution is found in our brains. From the brain comes our pleasure, joy, pain and suffering. Through the brain we think, see and hear. Nature has equipped humans with 3 different brains.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

The reptilian brain is the first and oldest brain. It is the brain of the past, memory of the experiences of billions of years of life, the seat of primal instincts, desires and life programs, self-preservation and preservation of the species.

The dinosaurs were herbivores and multiplied numerous. Suddenly there were carnivores, their own life was threatened. Time for another brain that could quickly decide between attack or flight.

The limbic brain is the second brain of the present, the lightning-fast response to the moment, the brain of emotions between fear and aggression, self-assertion to the environment.

Thought processes and the logical connection developed with the primates. Time for another brain, which was able to plan and arrange.

The neocortex brain is the third, youngest brain. It is the brain of disposing of the future, the possibility of conscious planning, precautionary action, the brain of abstractions and logical connections, of self-confidence and individuality.

Everyone has these 3 brains, let's take a closer look at these brains related to the trader's profession.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

Reptilian brain

Orientation: past

Setup: Aligns too much with other traders

Entry: Has a good empathy, but dares too little

Trade Administration: In the calm lies the power

Exit: Get out too early, because he relies on safety.

Behavior on profit: Balanced

Behavior on loss: Balanced

The reptilian brain has a hard time trading because it works more isolated on its own, communication with other people is preferred. The empathy for very good chances is best developed, but one dares not enough. Problem is that one listens more to others than to oneself. Losses cause you to give up quickly. Profits are not invested because you put too much security. The chance is greater than the risk you are willing to take.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

Limbic brain

Orientation: present

Setup: Orient only to itself

Entry: Courageous but also thoughtless fast entrances

Trade Management: Is always hectic

Exit: Too late because he hopes for a turnaround

Behavior on profit: exaggerated joy

Behavior on loss: Excessive frustration

The red brain is in a sense a danger but also a great opportunity. The most daring trades are entered, which leads to huge profits or huge losses. You do not hear others because you know better. Losses lead to revenge trades, you want your money back, cost whatever it takes. Here there is only black or white, all or nothing. Either millionaire or welfare recipient. The risk is higher than the chance.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

neocortex brain

Orientation: future

Setup: Oriented only to numbers, data and facts.

Entry: considered and strategic entrances

Trade Management: Works on its defined rules

Exit: Increases too late or too early because it trades in numbers and facts.

Behavior on profit: hardly any reactions

Behavior in case of loss: hardly any reactions

The blue brain is always busy analyzing and correlating numbers, data and facts. Only if all parameters are correct will a trade be entered according to clearly defined rules. The suggestions of others are analyzed carefully and if they are convincing, they are incorporated into the own concept. Losses make you question your concept and spend a lot of time creating a new concept. Chance and risk are balanced here.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

Every human being has these three brains, which, in spite of great differences in structure and function, must work together and communicate with one another.

The big question is how strongly the respective part of the brains reacts in certain situations.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

This results in an infinite number of possibilities, which in detail reflect the personality of a person. Decisive for an improvement is always the insight that something would have to be improved. Role models are well suited for this. Not to copy the role models, but to learn from them first. Then I can train my own personality in the learned area.

So you could classify the traders in 3 categories:

1.The feeling trader

2.The dominance trader

3.The numbers data facts trader

All these categories are equally successful, the key is the right mix at the right time. However, the individual situation of the individual trader is also important. First of all, no pressure is allowed. If you have to live off the trading, the pressure is much higher than if you use money that you do not need.

Try to find out what kind of trader you are. Then start looking for role models. But beware, too often we look for like-minded people, they do not help us, because they think the same way as we do. In order to change something, you should look for someone as a role model who thinks completely differently than you do. If you decide on this direction later, you decide. It is important, first of all, to change your thinking. After that the action takes place.

Man learns only through pain or insight, when pain and insight come together the learning success is the greatest.

I wish you every success in doing the right thing.

Best regards
