Increase our hourly wage?

Hello dear subscribers,

Because the price movements in the forex market are purely coincidental, we can only increase our odds on the basis of probabilities. However, before we put together the different probabilities and assumptions about an interesting strategy, we still have to deal with a probability. This is about our hourly pay, or how much pip we can achieve in the different time units within a certain time. As always, the calculations made here are purely hypothetical and may differ significantly from reality.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

It will be clear to each one of you that there are different trends within an upward or downward trend. This can be seen at the latest when you install a zigzag indicator with the setting 4/2/1 and 8/4/2 in a chart. Today, we want to take a closer look at these different trends. Ten different trends in different time units should be compared. In addition to the seven known time units from D1 to M1, I added three more time units in the tickchart. T32 is approximately the 30 second chart, T16 is approximately the 15 second chart, and T08 is roughly the 8 second chart. A tickchart has the habit of forming significantly more candles in the event of high volatility and forming significantly fewer candles with low volatility. Thus, no unnecessary space is wasted in the chart at lower volatility.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

The example given here uses an average ATR of the last 10,000 candles. The average ATR in D1 was 82 pip in the last 10,000 days and 4 pip in M5. This means that 0.06 Pip per minute in D1 was achieved  and 0.81 Pip per minute in the M5. The resulting pip size was 82 Pip in the D1 and 1166 Pip in the M5. The T08 shows here with 5774 Pip the largest fluctuation range. It is quite clear that the number of this Pip within a day can never be reached in the trade.

The following calculations are purely averages and of course change daily. With a zigzag indicator with the setting 8/4/2 there are 25 trend lines in the M5 on average per day. On average, 12 candles and per trend line average 12 pip. Which does not mean that each candle reaches an average of one pip, as there are both bullish and bearish candles. If you were to trade these 25 trend lines per day correctly, you could achieve 300 pip. On average, a trend line runs just under 1 hour, and 0.2 pip are reached per minute. These 0.2 pip are an average for the whole day. From 09: 00-11: 00CET and 15: 00-17: 00 CET there is the biggest volatility within EURUSD. In the morning, Frankfurt and London are in the market, in the afternoon New York, Frankfurt and London. Within these 4 hours you can more than double the pip size per minute. So we come to a value of 0.5 Pip per minute in the M5. Since we want to compare different trading transactions, today we will only refer to one scalper. Only five time units are possible: M5 to T08.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

In the first case it is about 2 minutes to act in all five time units. We enter into ten trades, seven of which trade profits and three trades lose. The ATR is supposed to be the size of the stop and the spread is 0.5 Pip. The risk results from the stop plus the spread. We calculate with the average Pip per minute, which are achieved in the respective time unit. Of course, the trades are not all started at the same time, we wait for a new trendline to emerge. Within 2 minutes, different sizes of pips are created, resulting in a different risk-to-profit ratio.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

The result, in a calculation of 1 lot we can now see in the graph. Interestingly, it can be seen that the range goes from $ -115 to $ 200. However, one should also note here that the greater the risk profit ratio is the less likely it is to actually achieve that goal.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

In the following case we want to trade the respective trend lines within the highest volatility. We know that in the M5, a trendline lasts about 60 minutes. Within four hours, four trendlines are eligible, of which we choose and trade half of each trendline. 50% of the trades go into profit and 50% are lost. We take the average pip that is reached within the trend line and the ATR is the size of our stop. The odds ratio is 1: 4, except in the M5 there is 1: 2.7. So we have almost similar starting conditions.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

As a result, we will see that in the five different time units with about 120 minutes the same time was traded. The number of trades is different, only two deals have been completed in the M5 and 24 trades in the T08 . The profits are between $ 70 and $ 300. It becomes interesting, if one from that calculated an hourly wage. The hourly wages vary between 35 and 148 $. In my penultimate post, I showed that the downtrend is 30-40% faster than the uptrend. If you bet on pure downtrends, you could raise the hourly wage to just under $ 200.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

Since I prefer the T08 to trade I would like to make a comparison with the M5. Compared to the M5, I get 87 times more candles, so I can learn faster, if my created resistance zones are correct. With 282 different trends per day, I have 11 times more chances for a new trend. For every trend line I get up to 8 times more candles. Although I get three times less pip, I can get the same result in 15 minutes instead of 1 hour. In the T08 I can reach almost 4 times as much as in the M5. Within a day I get 12 times more trend sequences and have to wait an average of 5 minutes until a new trend arises. In the highest volatile time, I can earn 4 times more. Instead of $ 0.58, I can earn $ 2.46 per minute.

Of course, this approach is only one side of the coin, many things are crucial in order to be successful in the long term in this market. This representation does not mean that one succeeds. I just wanted to show once that you have to deal with many things in a market that arises by accident.

The world of scammers in the stock market

Hello dear subscribers,

There are approximately 5 million private traders worldwide who dream of becoming a successful trader. Unfortunately, according to statistics, only 2% (100,000 traders) will manage to live long term trading. 3% (150,000 traders) may earn a small additional income, but can not give up their job. And what are the other 4.75 million traders who have tried their luck on the stock market or in the forex market and possibly lost many $ 1,000? Well, most people will admit that they are simply not fit for it and will look for another job. Across Europe, the fraud rate is 1.15%, and if we set that rate around the world, just under 55,000 unsuccessful traders will consider how they can make a lot of money in the stock market environment without trades.

What is fraud?

1. Deception about facts

Objectively, there must first be a deception about facts. Basically, one can not be fooled about future circumstances, as far as the future circumstances do not already contain a probability statement.

2. The error in fraud

For a mistake it is necessary that the "deceived" has made a concrete idea. This misconception must be based on the deception act.

3. The Property in the case of fraud

Without this requirement being reflected in the law, it is recognized that in case of fraud, the deceived must make a disposition over their own or another's property. An injunction is any action that directly affects the assets.

4. The damage in the case of fraud

Due to the property order a damage must have originated. For the calculation of a loss, the value of the assets before and after the erroneous property decision has to be compared. If this comparison results in a negative balance, there is damage.

A fraud can be imprisoned for up to five years or fined. Unfortunately, this does not prevent many scammers from harming other people. What motivates a scammer who dreams of succeeding as a trader and receiving the recognition he would like? After a few years he realizes that he did not manage to defend himself against the market. He has lost some $ 10,000, but he has collected a great deal of information about the market during that time. He has an advantage over many beginners, a supposed experience. This experience is not worth anything, but nobody knows that. Now he wants to reclaim his lost money with the experience he has gained. This releases criminal energies that are used for his own benefit.

Curiously, most traders claim to be successful, but only 5% succeed, 95% inevitably have to say the untruth. Is that already scam? In principle, these people only cheat themselves and as long as they do not lose themselves in the assets of the other traders, that is up to each one. Nevertheless, it is dangerous when these traders claim to have found the holy grail and other traders animate their specific system 1: 1 copy. Many traders are beginners, but they are not stupid and recognize quickly to whether it is worthwhile information or not. Applying the fraud statistics to the 600,000 members of FF would bring the alarming figure of 6,900 fraudsters to light, wholeheartedly hoping that this assumption is wrong. Statistically it would be right.

There is a saying that nothing is in vain, not even death, for it costs our life.

This platform FF is an excellent knowledge base and interesting knowledge spreads incredibly fast. This is also very important as the big players have huge advantages over the private traders. I'm convinced that the big players are having a harder time each year in this market, as traders have started to share their knowledge. But this knowledge is also known to the big players and so you have to come up with new strategies over and over again to get the money of the small traders. While retail traders account for just 5.5%, retail traders lose most of their money, and it's easier to fool a private trader than an institutional one. This makes the market more complicated and difficult every year, and it has become a real challenge to succeed in this market. This means that every trader is forced to relearn every day and optimize his strategy. It's like in Formula 1, with a racing car and the experience of the nineties one would have no chance today.

The insights that we have today may only give us an advantage for a few months, after that we have to rethink. The consequence of this: In the long term, only those people who have the creativity to adapt to this market will be successful in this market. This is one of the reasons why EAs only work over a period of time and are worthless afterwards. Actually, one should pay for an EA only if one make even profits with it. (If one need such an EA at all)

Let's think about it for a moment, when a trader has found a system that earns 10 pip per day, why should he re-sell that system for money? If he trades this system with a lot, he earns $ 1000 a day. If this system is good, it can also increase the number of lot to ten or 100 a day. He could earn $ 10,000 or $ 100,000 a day. That's more money than he could ever earn with seminars or EAs sold. Perhaps the trader does not trust his own system and therefore sells it. In principle, we only sell when we no longer need something or when we can no longer afford it, or to make money from it. We should think about that.

Of course, there are exceptions, professional programmers who can help institutional traders with their work, but one has to assume that these EAs are incredibly expensive and not payable. If we take a closer look at the market of seminars and EAs, we will see that 95% of the offers are actually belong directly in the garbage. It is enough to watch some videos in Youtube.

The bad part is that it is made very easy for the cheaters. Even if you do not have a clue about investment strategies and stock markets, you can become an absolute stock market guru and gain a fortune within a few weeks, despite the lack of knowledge. The following story is not an invitation to cheat, but a sad example of a cheater who was arrested. His plan was to start a stock market information service and get  worldwide e-mail addresses from traders. Now 96,000 traders are contacted. Half of the 96,000 traders get an email stating that the EURUSD is going up next week and the other 48,000 traders are told that the EURUSD will fall next week. Suppose that the EURUSD fell the following week. Now one start again a mailing and write exactly these 48,000 traders who have previously received a correct market assessment. 24,000 traders are forecasting an increase in the EURUSD and the other 24,000 traders are recommended to bet on a falling EURUSD. If one have sent this newsletter five times using the same principle, one have 3000 subscriptions left, which get predicted five times in a row, a correct course prediction. If one can convince 50% of these 3,000 traders to pay $ 2 a day, $ 720 a year, for this newsletter, one are a millionaire. You see how easy it is to cheat, that's why I find that the penalties are far too low. The scams that were attempted in this case went awry, as some addressees simultaneously received two different predictions of the fraudster and filed a complaint.

Some who are unsuccessful begin to give seminars, or steal indicators, reprogram them, and resell them for expensive money. Some also make a deal with their broker and, when you broker a client, get a share of their lost bet. The list could be expanded significantly, but I leave it here. The fact is, we have to expect that in the Forex market around 55000 fraudsters are traveling around the world. Of course, not all trainers and sellers of indicators are scammers, but one should always be critical at first. How many times have we ever bought everyday items that were junk because we did not get detailed information. Even positive reviews on the internet are becoming more and more fake today, which does not guarantee a good product. Not every unsuccessful trader needs to be a scammer at the same time, but a cheater is definitely an unsuccessful trader.

And for cheaters who want the hard-won beginner money, there should not be room in this forum. Once you get an offer, just post it to FF and ask if it's reputable, there are at least 600,000 traders who can help you out.

The fewer illusions we admire, the more we can absorb the truth.

The best chance to win

Hello dear subscribers,

In 1973, the theory of Efficient Market Hypothesis (EMH) became popular through the bestseller "A Random Walk Down Wall Street," written by Burton G. Malkiel. The thesis: Financial markets are efficient insofar as existing information is already priced in and therefore no market participant is in a position to achieve above-average profits through technical analysis, fundamental analysis, insider trading or otherwise. Above all, a vivid conclusion of the EMH, which the professor formulated at the renowned Princeton University in the US state of New Jersey, still provokes the experts today. Thus, the unpredictable nature of short-term changes in stock market prices causes a blind monkey to throw "darts" arrows at the financial pages of a newspaper, thus creating a portfolio that would be as successful as one that has been carefully selected by experts. Malkiel argues that asset prices tend to show signs of accidental change and that one can not consistently outperform market averages. In 1984, Warren Buffett gave a speech at Columbia University refuting the Efficient Market Hypothesis. After all, Warren Buffett is not a trader, but an investor.

thesis

No investor is able to outperform the market in the long term because the market can not predict future news and its impact on prices.

antithesis

The practice is not interested in the theory of the efficiency of the markets, numerous successes of investors prove this over many years.

Christmas 2010 Hanover has written a very readable report:

Twenty-six widely believed forex myths.

I recommend you to read this once.

Hanover writes there:

It's highly unlikely that you'll find a simple, mechanical system that allows you to win consistently, especially in the retail arena. If such a system existed, then everybody would use it -- or something conceptually similar -- and obtain exponential account growth with minimal knowledge, effort or stress. Large institutions could save themselves millions in salaries by dismissing all of their highly paid analysts, economists, veteran traders, math and statistics professors, and IT experts, and replacing them all with this simple system. But FX is a (pseudo)zero sum game: to remain handsomely profitable, you must effectively outwit, outplay and outlast the most knowledgable, experienced and ruthless minds in the industry, all of whom want to take your money, whether by fair means or otherwise. Hello dear subscribers,

With the summary of the different probabilities The best chance to win I would like to conclude our project number six. In this # 6 project, we saw how important the future market are to trading profitably in the forex market.

Our new project number seven will focus on how to use the stock market data to be even more profitable in the Forex market. Of course, there are some costs, but as a trader you are an entrepreneur and an entrepreneur always invests in his own company. The monthly cost of the stock market data and the trading platform is around $ 100. These costs are quickly back in with one profitable trade. We should note that a futures trader is three times more likely to win than a forex trader. I have described the reasons for this in detail. In principle, the stock market data can be compared with a navigation system and the forex data with a road map. In the navigation system I get a lot more information about weather, traffic jams, construction sites and much more and I'm able to reach my destination faster. It is clear that a navigation system is significantly more expensive than a road map. Anyone who lives off action should therefore think about the information he uses to risk his money. Let's take a look at how the stock market data can help us in our daily business.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

The price of EURUSD is always in balance or imbalance phases. Balance means the market is running sideways and imbalance means that the market is in a trend phase. In the H1 chart of the EURUSD H1 I marked the balance phases. In about 70-90% of cases, a market is within the balance phases. Of course, all traders try to take the strong breakout and trend phases, but the likelihood of achieving that is very low.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

Let's look at an example from a typical week in EURUSD. Within this week, there are five clear balance phases and three imbalance phases. It is very well known that it is ineffective to limit oneself to the trend phases. Therefore, as a trader, one should focus on the balance rather than the imbalance phases.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

With the market profile, the range trading is greatly simplified, because there are certain zones in which you can trade. Let's first look at the blue-bordered zone.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

In addition to the volume high and volume low zone, there is a POC zone. The POC is the zone where most volume occurred within a given period of time. Above this zone you should only look for long trades and below that zone only for short trades. However, the best entry is above the volume high and below the volume low zone. In this example, we see very well how the POC works as resistance or support. If you invest a volume profile after completing a course, the POC will always show distinctive resistance zones. Of course, within a course, the Volume High and Volume Low Zone will change regularly. I once shot a video about these zones to show them that the POC changes only slightly in this case. This is because there are certain price zones in which the volume is significantly higher than in other price zones.

Inserted Video

It is very interesting to see that after the first strong break down the POC zone was not changed anymore. In this case you could have done some interesting trades with it. Maybe this could be a motivation to get more involved with the market profile. There are many things to keep in mind that I will not go into in detail now. The market profile works best with the right stock market data.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

Let's look at another and interesting example of delta volume and absorption. In an overview in the EURUSD Forex market, we see from 10 to 18 September an interesting price trend. Initially, the price was in an uptrend, there was a sharp decline and within the same day, the losses were offset. At points A and B I have marked two resistance zones. The course was initially down and it formed at point C, an Equilibrium. After the sharp decline, it would have been possible to assume that the price is still going down. After the stop hunting at Point D, this range was a typical accumulation for me. The price initially went up and stopped within my resistance zone at point E. This was unusual for me at first, because in an accumulation phase, the big players collect first the Ask, to push up the price sharply. The fact that the course came to a halt could have only two reasons. The resistance zone at point B was so strong that the course could not get through or the big player could not collect enough Ask in the accumulation phase to push the course further up. That's why I took a closer look at the point E in the stock market in order to make a decision for the future course price.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

In the forex market EURUSD M5 Could not see much in this crucial phase. Therefore, I would like to show you once what it looked like in the stock market.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

In the Euro FX, it could be seen that in this phase an above-average negative delta took place. A delta arises from the sum of Bid and Ask. If the Ask is larger than the Bid, a green delta candle is created and if the Bid is bigger than the Ask a red delta candle is created. This high negative volume of deltas was created exactly at 09:00 CET with the opening of the London Stock Exchange.

To get more information, I've used a footprint chart to help look closer into the candle. Basically, I'd like to say that while a footprint chart is a cool invention for getting more information, the information is far from reliable. As you know, with a footprint chart you can see the imbalance in the market. An imbalance arises when between Bid and Ask a clear difference of, for example, 300% can be seen. This imbalance is always calculated in a candle from bottom left to top right. For example, if you notice a strong imbalance in a M 15 candle, it may be due that in a M 5 candle this imbalance no longer exists. This is simply because the price within a candle often goes back and forth a few times, watering down the imbalance. This makes it difficult to detect absorption with a footprint chart.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

Let's take a look at this striking zone with the opening in London at 9:00. In the 512 Tick Chart we can see that within four candles, a volume of 3769 bits and a volume of 1373 ask was traded. Of the total volume, just under 75% was traded on the bid and 25% on the ask. Nevertheless, the price has not gone down much. It was simply because there was a big player underneath that bought the whole bid.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

In the smaller footprint chart you could see that the strong sales orders have come into the market that have not moved the market down sharply, but effectively I could only see that in the DOM. Big players have a habit of disguising their absorption. They buy very quickly in succession with smaller quantities at certain price levels, the bid or Ask on. In the DOM one is able to recognize the purchased quantities.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

If a large number of sales orders arrive in the time & sales list, you can see in the DOM how the number of sales orders are counted up and wonder why the price does not fall. We know that a big player would never simply press the buy or sell button to push the price up or down. That means he has to collect Bid or Ask first. In the example shown, the question was: Why does a big player buy 3769 Bid? The answer: Because he assumes that the price will rise in the future. Thereafter, the price has risen by 60 pip. At some point a big player has to get off again and sell his 3769 Ask. What will happen after that? The course will fall. And that's exactly how it was. We recognize that a footprint chart is not the holy grail, but in combination with the time & sales list, the DOM levels, the volume delta and the market profile, you are already a step ahead. That's one of the reasons why the stock market data gives more information than a pure chart from the forex market. When we work with probabilities, correct data is an absolute must. In order to be profitable with a high probability in the forex market I can not do without stock market data.

I hope this little example can help to increase your future profitability. I wish you a nice weekend and next week a successful trading week.

The EURUSD forex market is only about 100 times larger than the Euro FX futures market. If the future DOM trades at a price level of 400 lots, then 40,000 lots would have to be converted into the forex market. But you are absolutely right with your idea, unfortunately this will remain an unfulfilled dream for all of us. But we are creative and know, how to help each other. With the absorption at the individual price levels, I have already come a long way in the last few days and will report about it in the next few days. Forex and Future Hyprid screens

Hello dear traders,

The data from the futures market are much more demanding because they also contain the correct volume and the number of trades. While we get two correct data streams in the Forex market (OHLC and Time) there are already four correct data streams in Future Market. This opens up an incredible field of data interpretation. In the past, I have traded my resistance and support zones based solely on supply and demand in the Forex market. Maybe luck, chance and my experience helped make it profitable for me. When my brother asked me many years ago what strategy I am using, my answer was: intuition and experience.The problem with intuition and experience is that you yourself can not define any measurable progress. Only when you research and write down your personal strategy will you be able to analyze, improve and recognize the changes. As an independent trader, you do not have a boss who asks for a regular work report or who asks you what you have done in recent weeks to get better. You can only change or improve things that you are aware of.

Uniting the forex market with the futures market is a challenge. Although the volume, the footprint chart, that Oder Flow and the Volume Profile are an interesting alternative in the futures market, these tools are not a holy grail. Whether the EURUSD possibly reaches the parity or rises back to 1.60 I do not care. If my friends ask me where the EURUSD currently stands, I often can not say it because it is unimportant to me. My basic definition of the market is supply, demand and equilibrium. In the Equilibrium or sideways market, big players collect Ask or Bid because they are pursuing a particular goal. Once you have the required number of contacts together, you have to confuse the market to take as few participants as possible up or down. So accumulation, then movement up and then comes the distribution, then the movement down. Accumulation and distribution does not always have to be in a sideways phase or in an equilibrium. This often happens towards the end of a trend. The challenge is to recognize this absorption in each phase. As I have written many times before, news is of no importance to me. Here's an example: Imagine the big player Goldman Sachs accumulating a large number of Ask in an accumulation phase. That can sometimes be fast some 100,000 Lot. Suddenly, information is coming in that the euro is getting weaker and the dollar is getting stronger. What is Goldman Sachs doing? They push the course up brutally and then gradually realize their profits. The press then writes that the euro has recovered. Of course, the big players are focused on market data and currency strength. But we must never forget that it is the big players who determine with their strategies where the market is going. So let's forget the news and concentrate solely on the strategies of the big players. The footprints of the big players in the market are the large absorption packages from Bid and Ask. We have to identify these, interpret them and create our strategy from them.

For the project number 7 I tried to direct my eight screens to the forex and futures market. For this I have created a short video to give you an impression of it. Please note that we are in a project and therefore I use different screen views that are constantly changing. Inserted Video

This saves me time and I am able to react faster. Another aspect is very interesting. If I have found a new screen setting or a new display style, I am able to test this setting for a certain amount of time without affecting my main view. In the footsteps of the big players

Hello dear traders,

In the past, I enjoyed working with the COT data, which was released every two weeks and showed the positioning of institutional and retail traders. Through a friend of mine, who accompanies our project 7, I was made aware of an interesting indicator in the trading platform ATAS. I have analyzed today and the result is incredible. With the indicator one is able to display the traded lot within one day as delta. So you could simulate a kind of short-term COT indicator, although no open positions are shown here. With a filter I have now divided this traded Lot. 1-4 lots for retail traders and 5 to 100 lots for big players. 5 lots are often used by the big player algorithms to buy Bid or Ask very quickly in sideways markets. With it, you can buy up to a few 100 lots within seconds, without displaying large purchase orders in the DOM. With this is a big player able to disguise his true intentions. That's why I chose the classification in the indicator.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

In the upper area you can see the price history of today. The yellow line is the delta of the traded 1-4 lot and the blue line is the delta of the traded 5-100 lot. Up to the blue arrow at 2:35 am the retail traders were still on the right track. After that, the delta has slipped into positive territory. This means that the majority of retail traders today were long-oriented. The majority of big players were short-headed. In principle, it is also logical, because if all traders wanted to trade down and no one up, the price would not move. As we known, the big players move the market, also we try to follow them. It is interesting that this indicator can also be used in the tickchart and thus can recognize very fast and up-to-date information about the orientation of the individual market participants. A course can only moved if there is a participant who wants to buy and gives another participant who wants to sell. The question is, which participants would like to follow in the long run, in order to act profitably. In principle, this indicator is very interesting, but it should be noted that in the so-called accumulation phases, the indicator could not help in the short term. And once again it becomes clear why so many retail traders lose. They lack important information about the actual market events. Unfortunately, we do not get this information in the forex market, but if you want to be profitable in the long term, you should deal with stock market data sooner or later.

I wish you a nice evening

Hello dear subscribers,

For over ten years I have been acting on the principle of demand and supply. That means before I start trading daily, I get an overview of the current market situation. Of course I am not able to determine the future course of the price, but I am able to identify certain resistance zones where the price may be turn.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

No matter which system you work with, you usually need a reference course for it. For example, a strong POC from the past. When a price goes up, I took the downtrend as the reference price before. When the price goes down, I need the reference price of the uptrend from the past. Our current reference price from the past is in 2016 2017.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

Dump Money against Smart Money

Hello dear traders,

Never buy the euphoria for the start of trading is a stock exchange rule that often comes true in the EURUSD. The institutional money "smart money" waits for a while, while in early trading, the private investors (like also unflattering "dump money" called) exposed motivated. The fear of missing something is very strong.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

Point A

A footprint chart is basically a zoom-in to the candle. On the left side, we see the number of lot that have been traded on the bid. On the right side, we see the number of lot traded on the ask. Trading on the ask means that the traders buy the euro and trading the bid means the traders buy the dollar. The color-highlighted numbers represent an imbalance within the candle. We do not want to deal with this imbalance today.

Point B

Here is a graphical representation of the volume delta. It shows the result between Ask and Bid. In the first candle, 649 lot were traded on the ask and 721 on the bid. 72 Lot more Bid as Ask were traded, so the delta is negative.

Point C

In the cluster statistics you can see the summary again. The session delta is the summary of bid and ask for the entire trading day. We see that the total 4905 Lot Delta is in the positive range.

Point D

The blue line is basically a graphical representation of the session delta. In the stock market there is now the interesting possibility to group this session delta into different lot.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

In the Euro FX, we look at the price development on Friday. For the big players we have chosen a range from at least 17 lot to 200 lot , which is shown with a red line. For the Dump Money we have chosen a range of a maximum of 1 lot, which is shown with a green line. The minimum bet in the futures market is 1 lot. We assume that someone who invests only 1 lot loses with a higher probability than someone who invests between 17 to 200 lot . Point A shows the overall price development in the 32 Tickchart, the price trend is bullish. Point B shows the delta of the big player and point C the delta of dump money. While the delta of the big players is also bullish, the delta of the dump money is bearish. Since both deltas calculate values of different sizes, they are calculated in two different fields to make the percentage change clearer. The Dump Money shown here is in more than 90% of the cases wrong during the day. From this one could derive an assumption. When the smart money moves in the opposite direction to the dump money, I follow the smart money. During the course of the day, smart money shows the possible price trend. However, one should be careful in the absorption phases, there the smart money will run in the opposite direction.

Inserted Video

Here is a video as an excerpt from the afternoon

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

Let's look at a section of the 128 tickchart within the day. At the blue arrow the number of volume deltas of the big players increases strongly, also the price course is bullish. The question: Was there bought Euros or sold dollars to push the price up? Why is this information important?

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

Point A

If the market price in the EURUSD rises, it means that the euro is stronger and / or the dollar weakens. If the market price falls, the dollar is stronger and / or the euro weaker. You will also receive excellent information in MT 4 about the currency strength. I have already reported on the currency strength indicator several times.

Point B

When someone presses the buy button in the EURUSD, he buys the euro and at the same time sells the dollar. Once he has reached his take profit and gets out, it means he is selling the euro and buying the dollar at the same time. If the price moves down after the entry and triggers the stop, the euro is being sold and the dollar is being bought. When someone presses the sell button, the opposite happens.

How does that help us?

When we are in an accumulation phase, the big players in this sideways market are increasingly buying in a large number of Ask. Before pushing up the price, you usually want to get rid of smaller traders who also bought Ask. That's also logical, because if they take the smaller dealers up, they will eventually get off. When the smaller traders get out, they have to sell the euro and buy the dollar at the same time. Depending on how many get off on the way up, this could slow down the course significantly. To avoid this scenario, before the actual eruption, there is an outbreak down, with the aim of stop fishing. So, once you've identified an accumulation phase, in the forex market, with an 8-tick chart, you'll be able to see when trader stops are triggered. At that moment you normally only see the course go down fast and hard. Many then assume that it is a breakout down, get in and get stopped.

Point C

If the price goes up, you should always ask yourself whether the euro is being bought or the dollar is being sold. If the price goes down you should always ask yourself if the euro is sold or the dollar is bought. This question can be answered a bit easier with the stock market data, but usually this will be a big challenge. In certain market situations, this approach may help further.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

Let's take another look at the previous example. At first the price went up and there was a sideways market with a slight upward tendency. The bullish volume has fallen, so many traders have assumed that the market is now down. The big players pushed up the market again with a high number of Ask, triggering the traders' stops. As a result, the market has been pushed up again. At the top high, the big player has sold his euro while buying additional dollars. That pushed the price down sharply. After that, the course went down. Of course, this situation must not have happened the same way, but it helps if you know how a big player in the market. The more accurate you become in this area, the more likely you are to be able to see certain course progression ahead. Of course, we are fooling ourselves regularly, but if you try to implement those ideas, you will most likely be able to optimize your profits. It is very important in the sideways or equilibrium to pay close attention to whether the big players buy more Ask or Bid. This absorption in the Ask or Bid are rarely handled with large contacts, but algorithms help the big player to perform the absorption in small numbers. Nevertheless, one is immediately able to determine in the chart that the positive delta of the big players rises sharply. At the same time, there is often a negative delta in volume within the sideways market. In this case, it is an accumulation and you just have to wait for the right entry up.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

In addition to the ability to group the volume delta into different lot, I'd like to see the change in the total delta. On the right side you can see the time, Bid and Ask and next to it the session delta. With this information you can capture the market situation faster.

Who wants to swim with the big sharks, must know how they move and why. That's why I started to deal with these big players a few years ago. I've found it's very hard to catch the breakouts and get pulled up or down. Therefore, the crucial phases are the sideways markets where I can trade back and forth within Vol H and Vol L. Nevertheless, it is possible to take the breakout phases with you and then let the course run for a few hours. If they are able to think like a big player, they are also able to guess where most of the trader's stops are and can accurately see when those stops are triggered.

If you move your take profit too fast in strong up or down phases, you will be stopped relatively quickly. When the price move up I often put my stop under the second low, when the price move down I put my stop over the second high. Should I be stopped then I'm not annoyed, because I earn my money in the sideways phases and not in the breakout phases. If I could get through a breakout and follow the big player up or down, I'm glad because it's a nice extra income. If I'm stopped at the second low or high, I have not lost any money. I do not work with a traling stop, because he is not able to recognize the strategy of the big players. Moreover, every situation is unique and not predictable from the outset. So I decided not to work with an autopilot. My favorite folders are the Market folders, where I've gotten used to buying in a falling price and selling in a rising price. If I have calculated the resistance zone correctly, I am thus faster in the profit.

Awareness of the market is crucial. Similar to a piano book with notes, the price history in EURUSD also tells us a story. We have to translate this story and we need to be able to see what is happening right now by the price history. When I am in the market during the day, I also try to interpret the courses and find out who is battling against whom. Over time, you will be able to more accurately identify trends and course trends. Of course, there are also days for me that does not work at all and I am completely wrong. Then you just take a break, get back in later or wait for the next day. The worst thing is boredom trades or revenge trades, because you think you have to make a profit. There are days when nothing works properly, then you should not act.

It also does not matter if you lose 1% in a day, much more crucial is how the result looks at the end of the month. If you deal with some of these things in the future, the monthly result could be much better. I wish you that from my heart.

A great weekend and a great start to the new week

best regards

Avoid stop fishing

Hello dear traders,

When I started to trade, I thought the big players were after me, as they fished my stops over and over in the outbreaks. It is indeed annoying when you have made a correct forecast but still makes losses. This is because most retailers have positioned their stops at a similar price level and the big players know that very well. Why are the big players in the wrong outbreaks interested in fishing the stops from traders? Now, first and foremost, the big player can get liquidity and improve its position. At the same time he throws all trader out of the game he would otherwise have pulled up. Although this is not a problem for the big player in the beginning, it becomes a problem when the first ones get out of the market and thus slow down the course. This solves the big player two problems in one fell swoop, the market unfortunately works like this.

These outbreaks with stopFishing are most likely to occur in the accumulation and distribution phases. With a little flair, you may be able to avoid the mistakes in the future. I would like to give you a few examples and a few tips on how to avoid this in the future.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

Here we see a 512 tick chart in the EURUSD from August 23rd. On the left side we see course down again and flows into a sideways market. At point A, the price seems to rise again, but that happened a short time and then there was a downtrend again. In the equilibrium point B is the course goes slowly up, that has a very specific reason we will look closer. At point C is a false breakout after that, the course runs 100 pip above. Of course, this works in the opposite direction in a distribution. If we look closely, we realize that we have to deal with many false outbursts several times a day because they are not just in the accumulation and distribution phases.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

One way you should pay attention is the market profile. At the points A, B and C we recognize a kind p in the form of the profile. This is often an indication that the course may possibly goes down again. Oppositely there is the b that often signals an upward trend. Of course you can not always rely on the market profile. In that case it would of course have worked. Please note, however, that this market profile unfortunately does not work in the MT 4 because, as already mentioned, there is no concrete volume. I will publish a separate article on this.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

At point A and B, the big player would have had the opportunity to buy Ask and then push the price higher. In the outbreak is striking that he does not run under the last low, but that does not always necessarily happen. The background is this: if the big player pushes the price down, he does not have to invest too much in that, because he knows that there are the stops of the traders there. As soon as the first stops are triggered, a kind of chain reaction develops and in our case the course accelerates downwards. Possibly the big player would have had to kick again, but he has renounced in this case. When the course triggered the stoppages, the big player closed its position immediately and threw an additional buy order into the market. As a result, the price has gone up very high. At this high point, many traders have dropped out and the big player has bought many of these orders and pushed the price further up.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

Let's take a brief look at the Equilibrium phase just before the outbreak. At point A and B we see a strong negative delta. This means that in this candle more Bid than Ask has been traded. Nevertheless, the price has risen rather than fallen, which shows that someone has bought at this point so the price could not continue to run down.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

As we zoom in on this equilibrium it becomes clear that there was a very good way to buy Ask.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

For a better overview, I have aggregated the footprint chart. You can now see more effectively what has been done on each level. Overall, the big player would have had the opportunity to buy in the nine candles 7800 Lot Ask. Of course that would not have been possible because there are other market participants. But I'm convinced that he has shopped here again.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

With the horizontal volume representation, you can see very well in which area was heavily purchased.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

More interesting for me is the horizontal volume delta, because it can represent the zone a little more accurately. In the volume delta you see a clear surplus in the area of the ask, for many traders this is an indication that thr price has to go up. However, one does have to do exactly the opposite in order not to lose. So, first of all, act down. The moment the other traders' stops are triggered, this is a fast and clean business. However, one must not be so greedy otherwise the nice profit is faster away than you can blink. Green deltas at the outbreak signify the activation of stop-sellers and entry into a trap of reckless buyers. Red deltas in the support push mean the activation of stop-loss effects of the buyers and the entry into a trap of reckless sellers. Of course, that always depends on the time unit.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

Although the forex market is one of the heaviest markets in the world, there is a very interesting strategy in this tough game. You have to earn your money where others lose a lot. And that's exactly the moment where the trader stops are caught. The advantage of this false breakout is that it is very fast and usually gives you a good chance of winning. Wherever they lose the most money you have the chance to win the most. So it is very interesting to act the wrong outbreaks. However, one should also know that it is a false breakout and realize its profit as quickly as possible. If you are still fast enough you have the opportunity to act in the opposite direction.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

In order to become professional in this area you should always know where you are right now. Therefore, it is essential to determine if you are currently in an accumulation or in a distribution phase. With a little practice, this can be achieved over time and as soon as the first gains are achieved it is even fun.

I can only give the recommendation to get into the position of the big players. In my recent contribution from Dump Money and Smart Money, I showed you the positions of each trader. I admit that sometimes I do not know exactly what the big players are planning to do, but then I focus on the retail traders and just do the opposite. Of course, this does not always work because sometimes the retail traders are right. But that is usually only for a short duration.

In 1912, G.C.Selden wrote the book: The Psychology of the Stock Market, citing an interesting wisdom:

The biggest mistake of 99% of investors is that they are optimistic at high prices and pessimistic at low.

Likewise, the following quote comes from him:

I believe that the desire to find a simple mechanical formula accounts for most of the losses on the stock market.

Perhaps to stop the attitude of finding the holy grail and concentrating on the essential facts in the market could lead to a more profitable future. The correct stock market data could be a solution.

I wish you a successful week

best regards

--- 帖子 #1077 ---
Volume in forex

Hello dear subscribers,

As promised in my last post, I would like to go into more detail on the volume in the forex market. First of all, it is important to know how the volume is calculated in the forex market and future market.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

We start at point A in the futures market and take an M1 candle as an example. There are market participants who buy dollars (Bid) and market participants who buy the Euro (Ask). In a footprint chart, the number of bid and ask on a price level is juxtaposed. The numbers in this candle are the number of Lot traded within Bid and Ask at each price level. This is a bit different at Forex Market Point B. The volume is calculated here from the ticks. A tick corresponds to a price change within the forex market. However, the number of ticks has nothing to do with the amount of Lot within Bid and Ask.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

Let's take a look at an example from the exchange-regulated market, where there are concrete and comprehensible information that is the same for everyone. Here is a short snapshot of 6 minutes in a 1 tickchart from last night. A tick means a trading transaction that has led to a price change. We can see that up to 25 lots have been traded within a trade to bring about a price change. Up to 20:00 CET last night, 204,000 Lot were traded, an average of three Lot per second. on the right side you can see a footprint, on the left side the number of traded lot and next the number of trades. In the middle candle 63 Lot with 42 trades were carried out within 1 minute. This means that tick volume indicates the number of trading transactions. We know, that the volume in the Forex market indicates the number of trades, while the volume in the stock market reflects the number of traded lot. We compare apples to pears. The only reason a price moves is the number of traded lot on the Bid and Ask and not the number of trades.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

Let's take a closer look at this in the exchange-regulated market. Within 23 trading days, the daily ask, bit and total volume have been analyzed.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

On the left side you can see the calculation of the volume and below that the calculation of the ticks. On October 12, 304,008 lots were traded in 165,768 ticks or price changes. At first glance, the two tables look similar, but on closer inspection and there are significant differences. On the right side, I have listed the individual days exactly. At Point A you can see the traded Ask and Bid. The number of ask and bid is almost identical, which is also logical, because a trade always involves a buyer and a seller. At Point B, we see that the average daily trading volume was 158,155 lot. PointC: On average, there have been 90,954 trade changes or ticks per day. Point D: On average, 1.73 Lot were involved in a price change. You can see that the volume / tick value changes, there are deviations up to 30%, in the overview on the left side you can not see that.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

Here on the left side we can see again the average ticks of 90.954 in the 23 trading days in the stock exchange market. The volume in the forex market refers to the ticks and there were on average 80,123 ticks during the 23 trading days. Since the Forex EURUSD is much more volatile than the Future Euro FX, I doubt the correctness of the volume in the Forex market.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

As I have proven with videos several times, the movements in EURUSD and Euro FX are almost identical. The price difference results exclusively from the swaps. In the stock market, you do not expect pip but ticks. When the futures market moves one tick, the forex market changes by 5 pipettes. Often you can see that the price in the futures market remains at a certain price level, while in the forex market the price moves back and forth. So if the volatility in the forex market is significantly higher than in the futures market, the tick volume in the forex must be higher.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

As we know, the EURUSD Forex market is about 100 times larger than Future Euro FX. If the calculation of the ticks in the forex market were correct, this would mean that in the forex market within a tick a volume of 212 Lot and in the futures market just under two Lot are traded.

What speaks against, that the number of the volume in the Forex market is right?

This is clearly counteracted by the higher volatility that takes place in the forex market. If we have 10 price levels in the futures market, than we have in the forex market 50 price levels. This also speaks for a higher volatility in the forex market.

What speaks for that the number of the volume in the Forex market is right?

Since the forex market is 100 times larger than the futures market, it would be logical that the number of plumb bobs per tick should be 100 times greater. Another argument that speaks for it is, that very few retail traders actually trade in the Forex market, basically only through the platform of each broker. Most brokers do business internally. That means, only from the time when there are more buyers than sellers, the brokers secure themselves over the Forex market. This hedge is usually a higher number of Lot. That would explain that in the forex market, in fact, only a higher number of lot would be traded. Effectively, I am convinced that the volume in the forex market is not correct, because if you trade exactly in volume, you would lose in 90% of the time. Moreover, in the interbank market, the actual volume is obscured, since the banks themselves have to protect themselves. We know that many banks earn up to 60% of their annual profits through the forex market.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

If we know that the price movements in the Forex and Future are moving in parallel, then the volume would have to behave in parallel in parallel. As we can see in this comparison, this is not the case. The volume calculated here in Forex is the volume we receive from our broker and this volume is clearly wrong.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

I now had the crazy idea not to use the volume of the broker, but to calculate from the price of the Forex market. You can see this calculated volume from the price in the middle. Although it does not yet approach the volume of the futures market, it is much more accurate than the calculated volume of the broker. I am convinced that this calculation can perform much better calculation in the forex market than the volume of the broker. That is why I will once again provide this indicator today.

Conclusion:

The interbank market is the largest market in the world and the largest banks see this platform as an excellent way to maximize their profits. This market is not regulated by the stock exchange, so there is no reason for the banks, that we can look into their cards. That's why the volume we're seeing is definitely wrong. Even if we could see the concrete volume of the banks, that would not help us. The volume is nothing but the result of Bid and Ask. But to make trading decisions, you must seen the number of Bid and Ask on each price level side by side. This information is not available in the forex market. That is why I use the stock market data to obtain detailed information which I can then implement in the forex market. I hope I have been able to show you exactly why volume trading in the Forex market brings more losses than profits. The indicator I provide will work better than the volume of the broker, but stock market data remains the best choice.

However, there is a small bright spot in the forex market, the calculation of the price is correct depending on which broker you use. The price arises from the ticks. This means that if you want to break down the price in order to better recognize resistance zones, you should only work in the tickchart in the future. Over that I will publish another article in the next few days.

I wish you a successful day

Best regards

Why a tickchart provides the better information

Hello dear traders,

In my last post volume in Forex, I have specifically pointed out why the volume in Forex market can not be displayed correctly. However, the price and time presentation in the forex market is very accurate. Unfortunately, we have only 9 different time units in the MT4 of which a scalper can use the maximum of the M1, M5 and M15. This is a relatively small area where you move. In addition, the information within an M1 is very poor and little meaningful. Although the determined volume from the ticks is not correct, but you have the chance within a tick chart, the prices of the Forex market to break it down better. This makes it easier, especially as a scalper, to detect resistance zones more efficiently and faster. Additionally, within the tick chart you can optimize and change your time units in ticks. This can identify resistance zones that are impossible to recognize for most traders who work in a normal time chart. At the end of the article I will give an example of this claim.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

In the picture we compare the EURUSD H4 with the EURUSD in a 16384 tick chart on the forex market. The main advantage of a tick chart lies in the resolution of the individual candles. When volatility is low, fewer candles are formed. With a high volatility significantly more candles are formed, which simplifies the overview and the drawing of resistors. In a breakout, a strong candle in the M1 will not do you any good. With a tickchart you may get a total of 30 candles instead of a candle and can immediately recognize the resistances. We see that the price trend on the chart of H4 and T16384 is almost identical. Under the respective charts is the bit and ask indicator, which I already posted in my last post.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

I have now enlarged this indicator to show the differences. It is undisputed that this indicator transmits significantly more information within a 16,384 tick chart. Let us first change to a smaller unit of time to see the concrete benefits.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

We are here in the M1 EURUSD. Within 17 minutes, 17 candles are formed. The Bid and Ask indicator also gives you 17 pieces of candle information. For a scalper, that's relatively little information with which he can actually do something.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

We now create a 64-tick chart and receive 25 instead of 17 candles during the same period. At the same time, the information in the bid and ask indicator is almost 50% larger.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

42 candles are already being created in a 32 tickchart. That's 150% more information in the bid and ask indicator as well.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

The 16 Tick Chart already reveals 92 candles within 17 minutes. The Moving Average EMA 200 already gives better information here than in the M1. Personally, I pay less attention to the EMA 200, this should only serve as an example.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

For me, the smallest time unit within a tick chart, with which you can still work well, is the T08. While there are 17 candles in the M1, the T 08 already displays 187 candles - 11 times more information. This information is much more meaningful to a scalper, and it makes resistance zones easier to create. If the volatility in the morning is still very low, you can work well with a T08. If the volatility in the afternoon rises sharply, you can relatively easily increase the number of ticks displayed. This flexibility is irreplaceable for me and can not be compared to a timechart.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

Now let's compare our bid and ask indicator in the M1 to a T 08. I believe it becomes clear that we get a lot more information in the T08, which we as Scalpers can implement very quickly. If that's too much information for you, you can simply turn up the tickchart. This guarantees your optimal time unit.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

The example below is about creating resistance zones within the M1 and T08. The blue arrows mark the zone in question in the different time units. In the T08 you can see how the price has gone up and down again. In addition, two gaps were created, which clearly show the strength up and down. In the M1 you have only one wick in the same period of time with which you can not do anything at all.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

Here we see the result that results from the marked resistance zone. This resistance zone could never have been drawn in the M1, as this was simply not apparent. An additional important aspect is the recommendation to work with the Bionic candle. The last pullback in a candle is the deciding factor. This takes into account the Bionic candle. Detailed information can be found on this blog.

As Scalper I work in the tick chart most with the T08, T16, T32, T64, T128, T256 and T512. With one click, I can double or halve the tick units without leaving or changing the offline chart. To get a bigger overview it is not a problem to switch to higher tick units like the T16384. In combination with the Bionic candle, I am thus relatively easily able to determine resistance zones that are not recognizable in a unit of time. A tick arises due to a price change in the forex, which means with a tick chart I am closer to the actual resistance zones than with any other time unit. The downside is that a tickchart is not time-oriented like the M1. However, I do not care about the time and the price. In the forex market, I focus on my resistance zones and currency strength. Accumulation and distribution are much easier to identify in the tickchart than in a time chart. Anyway, I get the crucial information from the futures market, which makes it much easier for me to start a trade. I recommend experimenting with the tickchart to find out if it will personally benefit you. Of course I'm convinced of that, but you have to try it out first. This does not cost money, but valuable time. But as a successful trader, you always have to be prepared to invest, including your valuable time.

Here you get more information about the tick data. In addition, we compared and evaluated some providers of tick data.

Is a tickchart really beneficial?

Thanks to all Subscriber

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

Hello dear subscriber,

First of all, I would like to take this opportunity to thank all subscribers who support this blog while welcoming all new subscribers. There are different people in this blog with different intensions. We all have one goal in common: to get ahead in our knowledge and we can all be very proud of it. Winston Churchill has said two important things in his life: Personally, I am always ready to learn, although I do not want traditional instruction. I would like to take this principle to heart in this blog, because my view of the market is neither right nor wrong, just a hypothesis. And the hypotheses of today can be the knowledge of tomorrow. The second important sentence that Winston Churchill has coined is: "It is a great benefit in life to commit the mistakes you can learn from as early as possible. That's a very important key phrase for us traders. To avoid mistakes, you first have to identify errors.

This experience from other traders , will help us. An experienced trader needs to be willing to share his knowledge with others. From a successful trader you can learn how to do it, from a less successful trader you can learn what to avoid. For this reason, the experience of others is an important part of the path to success. If we avoid the mistakes that others have already made, we will save an incredible amount of time and money. This is basically an incredible treasure that you will appreciate later. Therefore, I would like to take this opportunity to thank all experienced traders who are willing to share their knowledge with others.

In general, we all try to determine at very short notice whether buyers or sellers are in control of the market. This creates ideas for a possible trade. The crazy thing about trading is that at first glance it seems very easy, the course goes up or down. Two options you can bet on, a 50% chance. But then one realizes that the probability in the forex market is 5.2% and in the futures market is 16.6%. Although the probability in roulette with 48.6% is much higher, but there is a decisive difference. The ball in roulette has no memory of what numbers it has already started. Currency strength in the forex market

(You can download the described indicators at the end)

Hello dear traders,

The forex market differs from other financial markets at a very significant point: it consists of currency pairs. When you take a position, you trade two different currencies at the same time. This offers many interesting opportunities, as you can, for example, capitalize on your views on two economies with only one position. Therefore, it is difficult to look at the performance of a single currency in isolation.

Take as an example the EURUSD as a currency pair. If the price rises more in one day, there may be two reasons. The euro is particularly strong or the dollar particularly weak. It could well be that at the same time the euro is strong and the dollar is weak. There are different currency strength indicators with different calculation approaches.

Before I share my personal experiences, however, I would like to quote a few statements from Hanover. Hanover is a very experienced member of FF who enjoys a high level of acceptance and a very high reputation in this forum.

His statements about Currency Strength Meter:

But, assuming that there are no coding errors in the indicator calculations, accuracy is dependent solely on the price data being provided by the broker or market maker.

Which brings me to my next point(s). Firstly, all CSMs are derived from price, and price lags sentiment. In an industry where getting quickest access to quality information can provide a competitive advantage, institutional traders tend to use indicators that quantify sentiment, economic flows, orderflow/liquidity etc. (Many of these indicators are proprietary and lie beyond the scope of 'retail' charting packages like MT4).

Secondly, all price analysis is retrospective, and as price moves as waves within waves, this opens the door for arbitrariness that can only be resolved by selective bias. To explain with an example: the last 10 candles might represent an up-move, but these may be the most recent part of a larger sideways move, which in turn may be part of a larger down-move. Hence, like all other technical measures (e.g. moving averages, regression lines, etc), the price-derived CSM measure is determined arbitrarily by the historical horizon that's under study. There is no objective way of proving that one horizon is superior to another, that one way of calculating the value is superior to another, and hence that one CSM is necessarily superior in its 'accuracy' to another. All are ultimately giving a retrospective view of what price has done, and have no greater predictive value than price itself (or any other derivative of price).

Thirdly, predictive value comes down to the strength of the underlying sentiment which is determined by a number of fundamental reasons, many of which are economic, structural and/or logistical. If, for example, a CSM says that EUR is weak and USD strong, then the downtrend in EURUSD will continue only if there are overriding reasons -- i.e. reasons that underlie price -- causing it to do so. A price based CSM is not equipped to take these fundamental factors into account.

Fourthly, a CSM is merely a tool, and it is down to the trader, and how s/he interprets the strength/weakness measure, and uses it in the context of an overall trading system, that is an ultimate determinant in success or failure.

These statements from Hanover are important for now, before we take a closer look at individual currency strength indicators. Basically, I do not recommend spending money on a currency strength indicator. Within FF there are great traders and programmers who offer you different currency strength indicators for free.

More information is available at:

Recent Strength indicator

The different CSM indicators calculate the currency strength from the different currency pairs in the 9 available time units. Ticks are provided by the brokers, but not kept due to the high storage requirements. To calculate a currency strength in the tick chart, you would first have to generate all the currency pairs in the tick chart in order to derive a calculation from it. Thus a currency strength in the tick chart is not representable, because too expensive. In addition, a tickchart runs in the offline chart, which makes things even more complicated. Let us restrict ourselves to the 9 known time units in the MT4. I have tried different CSM indicators, which were also recommended by Hanover and use the following modules.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

MADdash indicator, Developer: honestknave high impact member FF. A multi-timeframe dashboard calculated from the price. 8 currencies CHF, JPY, CAD, USD, EUR, GBP, AUD and NZD are compared. This gives rise to the strength of 28 currency pairs. Green means strength, red means weakness. Time frames are possible from M1 to MN. The indicator can be used individually. More information is available at:

MADdash (Moving Average Distance)

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

From the professional indicator of honestknave I have created an optimal representation for me. If the dollar is strong only a red color appears, if the euro is strong, a green color appears. With that I achieve a better overview for me.

Point A: In the upper red boxes, the strength of the dollar from M1 to MN is calculated against the following currencies: CHF, JPY, CAD, EUR, GBP, AUD and NZD. The last two candles are calculated.

Point B: In the red fields, the dollar moves from M1 to MN against the following currencies: CHF, JPY, CAD, EUR, GBP, AUD and NZD. Only the current candle is calculated. The lower field (Point E) is a summary of the 7 fields above. I have hidden this series in my current presentation.

Point C: In the green fields, the Euro changes from M1 to MN against the following currencies: CHF, JPY, CAD, USD, GBP, AUD and NZD. Only the current candle is calculated. The lower field (Point E) is a summary of the 7 fields above. I have hidden this series in my current presentation.

Point D: In the lower green boxes, the strength of the Euro is calculated from M1 to MN against the following currencies: CHF, JPY, CAD, USD, GBP, AUD and NZD. The last two candles are calculated. On the right is a bionic chart (64 tick) for the video overview.

Inserted Video

The price is in a downtrend for the first 2 minutes, the strength of the dollar is clear. After 2 minutes slowly arises a euro strength, whereby initially the dollar is strong. The strength of the euro is increasing and the price is rising.
However, this type of ad is very short-term and therefore very volatile. It shows me very fast price changes, which are not always reliable. Basically, I warn against start a trade based on these views. In an ongoing trade, this can be very helpful at times to avoid getting out too early.

Attached Image (click to enlarge)

In addition, I also like to use the following indicators

CCFp Indicator, Developer: SemSemFX, Interesting currency strength meter

+ RS_Group EUR & USD indicator, Developer: unknown, Very interesting strength indicator that reacts faster than the price chart. Here, the euro was currently compared to the dollar.

I recommend you to test these indicators during operation and to create your own interpretation. The big advantage of trading currency pairs is that there is a strength for the euro and the dollar, which often helps me identify what is happening in the market. However, this is no guarantee that this will remain so in the future. And for this we need the stock market data to detect possible absorptions in bid or ask. The Forex market is all about gaining an information advantage over most market participants.

If you identify the retail traders you usually have to act in the opposite direction, if you identify the big players, you usually have to act in the same direction. But that too can often go in the pants. Because when a big player collects Ask in a sideways phase (accumulation phase), the course does not have to go immediately straight up. Often there is only a fake outbreak down, to turn off the possible Ask buyers. Only then does the course go up.

But the more good information you have, the sooner you can work out an advantage. Therefore, you have to create a good setup from the abundance of different indicators. And with this setup, only you can do something. Therefore, the indicator settings of me or other traders do not help you. Every trader interprets the market differently. That's why I recommend testing indicators and interpreting them yourself. It does not matter what another trader says or claims. If you look at your screen and recognize a particular pattern, that can often be worth more than any well-intentioned professional advice. For that you need training and a lot of screen time.

If an indicator does not help you, leave it. After I work with the stock market data, I know what I have missed the last few years. But that too is not a holy grail. The key is to create an individual setup from the flood of information that increases your chances of winning. And only you can do it alone. This blog is a wealth of information about possible setups, but not a specific system. Choose the best, test it extensively and create your own individual system. It takes time and is exhausting, but in my opinion it is the only chance we have.

I keep my fingers crossed for you and wish you the necessary endurance.

best regards
