MT4 tones and sounds with different tone sequences and indicators

Hello dear subscribers,

the new video is online and, as always, you will first receive the English translation. You can find the link from the video and the indicators at the end of my post.

In today's post you will get two important pieces of information. First, what is more important, fundamental analysis, technical analysis, charting or reading out algorithms? Second, I am going to show you a specific way how you can use the MT4 to generate sounds in the Forex market and to take advantage of them. Of course you will receive an indicator and the tones I have modified to download.

Let us first come to the four big question marks in retail. As we know, we always work on the principle of probability to make a profit. How can we proportionally increase our probability of winning? Is it the fundamental analysis, the technical analysis, the chart technique or the algorithm analysis? The correct answer is both. In principle, I work with all four strategies, but I use them in different ways. I extract the fundamental analysis with data from the Forex market. For me, the technical analysis data can only be determined in the futures market. An optimal chart technique is only possible in the forex market, and the algorithm analysis can only be realized with stock market data.

In fundamental analysis, the question arises what am I buying? Since I only work in EURUSD, only the euro or dollar comes into question. The solution, a currency strength indicator that reacts faster than average. Due to the higher volatility, only the forex market is suitable for this, especially since there is no currency strength in the futures market. The reason for this is relatively simple. The strength of the dollar is determined by running the dollar against the seven major currencies. The strength of the euro is determined by running the euro against the seven major currencies. A corresponding distribution ratio must be formed from this, from which the respective strength is determined. Curiously, no one in the future market has come up with the idea so far, possibly also because the effort involved with virtual data would be far too high.

In technical analysis, the question arises why am I buying? First and foremost, it is about determining the phases of accumulation or distribution. These big players' collection campaigns take place 85% of the time and give a prospect of long-term price development. However, the calculation is not that easy. Therefore, identification is only possible in the stock market. As I have already shown in some videos, the limit orders must be specially filtered for this. This makes it possible to find out which market orders are actually accepted by the limit orders. The complete display of all limit orders does not show us the reality. In the upper image of the limit orders, one could assume that the big players collect massive ask to push the price further up. In fact, however, they have collected bids at this point, as you can see very nicely on the price that then descends. Only those who are able to correctly filter out the decisive limit orders can increase their probability of winning.

When it comes to chart technology, the question arises where do I buy? Using my self-developed bionic candle, I determine individual key candles in the M1 or M5, which show me the exact reversal points. Due to the five times higher movements in the price, only the forex market is suitable for this. You can find specific information about the Bionic candle and how it works in these two videos. Every trader tries to find the exact turning point in the chart, most of them fail. I felt the same way many years ago, for this reason I developed a candle where you can still see exactly which movements were the strongest afterwards. The exact key candles that show the future turning points can be determined precisely from this. Here you can see a strong M1 key candle that was 10 pips in size. This resulted in a future reversal zone. Since I only work with a stop of 1.5 pip, this zone would have been much too big for me. With the help of special tick charts in the Forex market, I am able to determine the strongest zone. In this case, I was able to reduce the key candle to two pips and thus determine the future reversal point much more precisely.

My charts in the futures market, which at first glance seem very complicated, are primarily used for algorithm analysis and the question of when do I buy and when do I get out? To do this, you have to go as deep as possible into the market to get the fastest information. I would like to explain this to you in more detail. Basically, the market only moves because the volume is flowing into liquidity. First I created a table in which there are three different strengths. Strong, Medium and Weak. I have now examined these three states of aggregation in all their variants. First of all in the area of buy market orders, then in the area of sell market orders. This resulted in three conditions that are possible in the market. The bullish move, the equilibrium and the bearish move. Ultimately, these movements result from the respective strength of the different order types. As we know, the market only moves because the market sell orders run into the limit buy orders and the brand buy orders run into the limit sell orders. Now let's imagine that the market sell orders have a strength of 80% and the limit buy orders have a strength of 50%. First of all, let's leave out the iceberg orders. In this case, the market sell orders would penetrate the limit buy orders. On the ask side, the market buy orders have a strength of 20% and the limit sell orders a strength of 60%. What will happen? The market buy orders are absorbed by the limit sell orders and the price is intercepted. Now let's add the whole thing up. The market sell orders and the limit sell orders reach a strength of 140%, while the limit buy orders and the brand buy orders reach a strength of 70%. It is clear from this that the course must be going down at this point. And that is exactly the whole secret. With special filter settings and the consideration of the iceberg orders, which can be read out using the spoofing information, only the individual strength of the individual order types has to be determined. Higher probabilities can then be derived from this.

In my video: How to react 20 times faster in trading, I have already gone into more detail about the tones I have developed. This is another key element to be more successful in the market. Our eyes have a reaction time of 30-40 ms, our skin reacts in 10-20 ms, our ears to sounds coming from loudspeakers in 3-5 ms and sounds from the headphones are perceived in around 2 ms. Our eyes are thus able to perceive 25 pieces of information per second. With our skin we can record 100 pieces of information, our ears 250 pieces of information and headphones up to 500 pieces of information per second. It is questionable whether the human brain can actually process 500 pieces of information per second, but they are available and can significantly increase the probability of winning.

With the precise analysis of the different information from the DoM and the time and sales list, one can find out interesting things with a creative approach. The executed limit orders show me the long-term market movement and with the executed market orders I am able to record the short-term market movement. The limit orders that have not yet been executed in the DoM give me a glimpse into the future. Here is a future willingness to trade, but one should be viewed with great caution. It is not for nothing that it is said that the Times and Sales List speaks the absolute truth, while the DoM produces one lie after another. And let's take a closer look at that. Since the Times and Sales list shows all market orders that have been executed, the statement that it is speaking the absolute truth is correct. In the DoM, the current price, the executed market orders as well as the best bid and best ask price are also the absolute truth. The lie lies in the limit orders as they can be added or subtracted at any time. This is also followed by the native or synthetic iceberg orders that we cannot see. On the other hand, the current spoofing information is true again. To what extent the iceberg orders increase or reduce our trading opportunities, we will take a closer look over the next few months.

First of all, we ask ourselves the question, how can we extract tones from price movements? To do this, we must first understand how a movement in the stock market arises in the first place. Let's take a closer look at this. Here we see the market buy orders, the limit sell orders, the market sell orders and the limit buy orders. The price line is on the best ask page. Now a 5 lot market buy order comes in, which reduces the limit sell order by 5 lots. Next comes a 5 lot market sell order. The price jumps from the best ask side to the best bid side and the limit buy order is reduced by 5 lots. Now a 10 lot market sell order comes in, the price remains on the best bid side and the limit buy order is reduced by 10 lots. Here we see a 10 lot market buy order, the price jumps to the best ask page and reduces the limit sell order by 10 lots. Now another 15 lot market buy order comes into the market, which runs into the limit sell order. This is where things get interesting as a 15 Lot Market Sell Order hits the market. All limit buy orders are eaten up and the price jumps a tick down. This now creates a small gap because the best ask and best bid are no longer linked. The gap only closes at the moment when another limit sell level is created. If a buyer were to buy into the gap, he would now have to pay double the spread. We see that a higher spread is not the fault of the broker, but is only due to a missing limit order. In this context, it was only important to understand how a movement in the market arises.

In the future market we can extract different tones. Bid, ask or the total volume, we can also create tones from the best bid, best ask. That is also my preferred approach. In the forex market, the creation of tones is limited to the ticks, as there is no specific volume. The volume in the forex market is specified differently by the respective brokers. If we compare this volume with the real stock market data, we see that there are clear differences. A few years ago I tried to create a forex volume from the price and we can see that it is much closer to the actual volume than the volume we received from our broker. Here you can download the indicator for free on my blog at Forex Factory.

https://www.forexfactory.com/thread/...2#post12451112

If we now extract tones from ask or bid in the future market, it would look like this. First of all, we could produce five tones. Then another five, then ten, and so on. We will now take a look at an example from the future market, where I created the tones in this case from best bid and best ask. We see and hear how the price goes down.

Due to the lack of volume, there are of course fewer tones in the forex market. The start begins without sound. The price increases by a tick, so there is a tone. While 10 tones are produced in the future market, the price remains in the forex market and no further tone is produced.

The price jumps up a tad, which creates another tone and so on. We will now look at an example from the Forex market, in which case I created the tones from the ticks. We see and hear the price going down.

Now let's take a look at how we arrange the tones from the stock market as an example. A price rises sharply, in order to participate an investor has to invest money. He buys the stock because he is hoping for a rising price. He makes this decision rationally. The price is actually up and its stock is doing well. Suddenly the direction changes and his stock goes down. His profit is getting smaller and smaller. He decides to pull out his money to keep his winnings. He makes this decision emotionally. The ask tones belong to the rational decision and the bid tones to the emotional decision. When we split up the Ask or Bid tones, we automatically ask ourselves which speaker channel we should assign these individual tones to? Information from brain research and body language help us here.

Our left brain is responsible for language, reading and arithmetic, logic, science, the perception of time and linearity. This is our rational brain. Our right brain hemisphere is responsible for the imagery, the feeling, our creativity, play, overview, holistic connections and the sense of space. This is our emotional brain. Because of a crossing of nerves, the assignment of the brain and half of the body is opposite. This means our left brain controls our right half of the body, i.e. our rational, right side of the body. Our right brain controls our left half of the body, i.e. our emotional, left side of the body. Our left half of the body is our emotional side while the right half of the body is the rational side.

The question now arises as to how our brain picks up a sound that is perceived by the left side. Sounds that reach the left ear reach the right hemisphere. The right half of the brain reaches our left side of the body, so the sounds from the left also arrive on our left side of the body. Sounds that reach the right ear reach the left hemisphere. The left half of the brain reaches our right side of the body, so the sounds from the right also arrive on our right side of the body. By the way, a very interesting side effect when you ask a person after a cigarette, his cell phone or for money, in which ear you should speak so that he is more likely to comply with the request. Incidentally, there have been many attempts at this, and the result is very interesting. One should speak into the right ear, since the tones run into the rational brain. The request is processed value-free and the chance is significantly higher. Since our emotional half of the body is on the left side and is also reached through the left ear, I arranged the bid tones exactly there. The ask tones therefore also run into the right speaker channel. By the way, as you can see in my previous videos, all of my charts are geared towards this.

Interestingly, a sound tick indicator has existed at Forex Factory since 2006. The basic idea is absolutely great, but I have a small suggestion for improvement that I will explain in more detail in a moment. There are different tone sequences for this, which I modified and adapted in detail. A total of five different tone sequences are available.

Market Pace1 the more ticks, the higher or darker the tone becomes

Market Pace2 two different tones A and B for all ticks

Market Pace3 the more ticks, the louder the sound

Market Pace4 tones are exactly the opposite of Market Pace1

Market Pace5 two different tones C & D for all ticks.

You can download the indicator and the different tones on my blog at Forex Factory. What you have to do can be found in my penultimate video: Forex Factory, "How Do I Find Like Minded Traders Near Me?" You can also find a link in my video description. First of all, the indicator goes into the MT4 folder where all indicators are contained. The tones must be in the Sound folder. This is located on the local data carrier. For this you have to go to Windows, under Programs x86. There you may find different saved files from your MT4 if you work with several MT4s. Now all you have to do is identify the right one. In my case this is MetaTrader number three, in the Sound folder you put the 5 sound files I created. The folder Market Pace without a name is required by the indicator and contains the same data as the folder Market Pace 1. If you want to try a different tone sequence, add the letter A to the first folder and simply delete the number in the second folder one. Then the tones are extracted from it. Once you've installed the indicator, it should sound something like this.

Let's come to my suggestion for improvement. Unfortunately, I don't work with the tones in the Forex market, otherwise I would have taken the time to modify the indicator myself. As you know, the indicator reacts to every tick. In my DoM declaration you saw earlier that the price often fluctuates between best ask and best bid until it finally breaks through a limit level. This limit level is then broken down when the price is two ticks from the best ask price or two ticks from the best bid price. So I would modify the indicator. A tick is counted as soon as the downward price is two ticks away from the best ask price. A tick is counted as soon as the upward price is two ticks away from the best bid price, which could provide more detailed information.

The tone indicator is particularly suitable for market participants who work in higher time units. Please note, however, that the tones are the same in all time units. A tick is always the result of bid and ask that run into limit sell or limit buy orders. A big advantage is that you can hear the movements in the market. Of course, you can also see them based on the price line. This has the advantage that you don't always have to look at the screen and you can always hear the movements in the background. Every trader has to try out for himself whether this will result in concrete advantages for future trading.

The tones I have made available are an introduction to working with tones in the MT4. Basically, I recommend working with tones from the stock market in the long term, as they are much more versatile. The tone frequency is also significantly higher and you can hear the strength of the limit orders through the tones. This results in far more opportunities in the long term to increase the probability of winning. I would be very happy if the information would help you. I hope you enjoy it and I keep my fingers crossed for the future.

Downward movements are 30% faster than upward movements

Hello dear subscribers,

the new video is online and, as always, you will first receive the English translation. You can find the link from the video at the end of my post.

In the last 11 years I have compiled important theses for my trading success from different probability calculations. You can see a selection of them running up the screen. There are no typical trends, just movements that result from the current market situation. Downward movements are on average 30% faster than upward movements. Acoustic signals can be perceived 20 times faster than optical signals My deciding factor is the pips per minute. Volume trading is ineffective in both forex and futures markets Currency strengths are a crucial factor in the forex market. The fastest information is obtained from time- and volume-independent charts. If you want to be successful in this market, you need the right technical equipment. Every trader should determine his optimal currency pair in order to achieve the highest probability of winning. Money management is an important fine-tuning to optimize profits, it is more crucial to get in and out at the right time. News and price are completely irrelevant to profits. An indicator in Forex primarily only translates the price with a different representation, but has the disadvantage of being lagging. The shorter the time spent in the market, the lower the risk of smaller breakouts being stopped out. There are no patterns in the price, the candles or the representation of indicators. The market makes the news and not the other way around. In 30% of the time there is movement, 70% of the time the market is in an equilibrium. Forex and stock market data must be combined in order to achieve the highest probability of winning. Success in trading depends on the effective screen time. It is easier to concentrate on the 12 biggest big players than on 1 million retail traders. Due to the different algorithms, market technology is now out of date. Smaller iceberg orders dominate the markets today. Bid and Ask do not decide about the future of the price, only the limit  orders. There are 2 different bulls and bears fighting each other in the market. Candles do not give any information about the future course of the price. The big players always work with a similar approach.

These theses have made many things easier for me in trading and possibly brought me the success I have always wanted. In the next few months we will pick out a few theses and analyze them in more detail. At this point I do not want to claim that my view of the markets is correct and that the way I trade improves your probability of winning. Every trader has their own opinion which I absolutely accept as everyone manages their own risk. However, we should help each other and there may be some information today that will help you in the market. If so, I would be very happy about it.

Today we will deal with the first thesis. Downward movements in EURUSD are on average 30% faster than upward movements. Now let's see to what extent this is true. In 2019 I analyzed upward and downward movements in the EURUSD on my blog at Forex Factory, with the help of my Bionic candle. I found that the average downward movements are between 29 and 39% faster than the upward movements. Since the price history of the EURUSD is already over 50 years old, I have now carried out an analysis that is 4 times more precise. The first basis was a monthly chart, where 126 different movements were examined. The advantage of a monthly chart is that it shows the movements more precisely than an M1 chart. The analysis determines the average pip values per candle. In the first and second charts we can see that the bearish movements are much stronger. The result of the analysis: the bearish movements were 32% faster than the bullish movements. This confirms my thesis, which I put forward two years ago.

We see a course in the M1 from May 12th, 2021. The blue arrow shows a number of 21.3, which is indicated by my zigzag indicator. What does this number mean? From the green line to the red line, the price has reached a distance of 6.39 pips. We now divide this pip by the number of three candles that were created in this route. That is exactly 21.3 pipettes or 2.13 pip. On average, each candle has reached a size of 2.13 pips. Since this is a 1 minute chart, a higher pip value automatically means a faster movement. For this reason I developed the Bionic Zigzag Oscillator a few years ago, which immediately shows me the decisive strengths in the overview. Here we see the three biggest strengths in the chart. Coincidentally, they are bearish movements. Now let's take a look at the last 50 years in the monthly chart with this auxiliary indicator. The strongest moves have definitely taken place in the bearish area. The bearish movements also dominate in the daily chart, although there are of course stronger movements in the bullish area from time to time. The bearish dominance can be clearly seen in the H4, as well as in the hourly chart.

First of all, we need to ask ourselves: why are the downward movements faster than the upward movements? There are two theories about this. As I have already shown in some of my posts, a price increase in the stock market arises from investing money. This investment is usually accompanied by rational decisions. When a price falls it means that money is being pulled out of the market. You want to secure your money or limit your losses. This often creates a chain reaction that is triggered by emotional behavior. It is easier to get your money out of the market than it is to invest it in the market. This means that emotional decisions often have a more dramatic effect than rational decisions. It is also known that pullbacks often have a stronger effect than the actual main movement. If we look at the course of the EURUSD over the past 50 years, we see that it is more of an upward movement. Within this upward movement, there are always quick pullbacks to stop the long traders. These could be some of the reasons why the EURUSD is moving faster.

Let us now come to the crucial point: What advantages can we derive from this information? A few years ago I took the trouble to analyze 96 of my trades in more detail. First, let's look at my 56 long trades. 68% win ratio, 32% loss ratio, 9.34 pips average profit and 7.26 pips average loss. The pay-off ratio, or rather the efficiency, was 1.29 and the expected value was 4.0. 40 trades were completed in the sell area. 80% win ratio, 20% loss ratio, 11.5 pips average profit and 7.8 pips average loss. The loss was thus even higher than with the long trades. The pay-off ratio was 1.46 and the expected value rose to 7.65. Then I merged the values for the long and short trades. 73% profit rate, 27% loss rate, the pay-off ratio was 1.39 and the expected value was 5.5. If I had now completed the 96 trades exclusively in the short area, I would have achieved significantly better results. In this case it would have been 207 pips more and the expected value would have improved by 38%.

Another point that may speak in favor of short trades is the security aspect. On January 15, 2015, the franc shock caused a downward movement of 2200 pips within a few seconds. Three years later there were extreme downward movements in some currency pairs. Interestingly, there has never been such an upward move before. Now let's analyze my 96 trades carefully. It took me an average of 4 minutes for the 56 long trades and was 224 minutes in the market. The short trades lasted an average of 2 minutes, so I was in the market for a total of 304 minutes. 96 short trades would have taken a total of 192 minutes, so I would have had to expose my money 112 minutes less to risk. That's a 37% advantage. Long and short trades combined produced a net result of 530 pips. That's a value of 1.74 pips per minute. With 96 short trades, I could have increased the pip value by 100% per minute. And that is exactly the crucial point for me. For my long and short trades I paid a 74.4 pip spread. The short trades would have cost me only 57.6 pip. That would have been an advantage of 22% in this case. In recent years I have often found that I often had to pay more spread for long trades than for schort trades.

Basically, I can recommend every trader to deal more with money management in order to find out which strategy is the best. This allows you to significantly optimize your probability of winning and you get regular feedback. That is the only truth that matters. My thesis: Downward movements in the EURUSD are on average 30% faster than upward movements, I would like to correct first. That this fact was so in the past does not have to mean that it will also be so in the future. The markets change regularly, so there can of course also be changes in this area.

Conclusion:

Whether my thesis will also be correct in this form in the future is questionable, especially since this analysis took place exclusively in EURUSD. You should analyze other assets yourself. However, it is much more important that you deal more closely with your money management in the future. This will help you find out which currency pair is best for you, whether you can handle short or long trades better and whether your strategy is still up-to-date. These numbers, data and facts may be boring, but they're like a trainer telling you the truth, unvarnished, every day. If you also pay attention to the pip value per minute, you can optimize your probability of winning significantly. But we'll talk about that another time. You can find the indicators on my blog at Forex Factory. I wish you every success with your future trading and would be happy if my information helps you.

Hello dear subscribers,

the new video is online and, as always, you will first receive the English translation. You can find the link from the video at the end of my post.

As I already showed in my last video, there are different theses that I have created over the past 11 years to make it easier for me to act. To say it right from the start, of course there are professional traders who value news and the price and thus also trade successfully. In this video we will take a closer look at why I do without it. You could possibly save a lot of time with these ideas in the long term and thus act even more efficiently in the future.

In the table we see that institutional traders as well as retail traders in the futures market place great value on volume and price. This does not seem to be the case with the big players. Let's take a closer look at why this is so. In many of my posts, we have already talked about the different strategies of the big players. 85% of these strategies take place through accumulation or distribution. During a sideways phase, Ask is collected and the price is pushed up. You either get out of your position afterwards, or there is a re-accumulation phase where further ask is collected. Now the price is pushed up and they get out of their positions. A distribution phase arises where the big players collect bids and the price is still running down. In the re-distribution phase, another bid is collected, the price is pushed down and then you get out of your positions, and the whole game starts all over again.

To collect this ask or bid, limit orders in the form of smaller iceberg orders are used. The big players are therefore dependent on the volume of retail traders, which is primarily absorbed by triggered stops. Although the big players control the market very well, it should be clear to everyone that no big player can precisely plan this recorded volume of stops in advance, as it always depends on the reaction of the retail trader. For this reason, the price levels do not play the major role here. Since I also follow the big players, the price is irrelevant to me. At the end of 2016, Deutsche Bank and many currency experts estimated that EURUSD would hit 0.95 by the end of 2017. Despite the assessment of these experts, it turned out completely different, meanwhile the price is back at 1.20. The highest price in EURUSD was 1.6038, and the lowest was 0.5365. This results in a theoretical mean of 1.0697, which is, however, factually incorrect, as the main volume took place significantly higher up. Theoretically, the price can also drop to 0.4 or rise to 2.0, so there is no top or bottom in the price. When the price rises the euro is stronger, when the price falls the dollar is stronger.

As I have already shown in my previous posts, there are no clear patterns within the price from which one could achieve concrete trading advantages. I don't care whether the EURUSD reaches parity or rises back to 1.60. When my friends ask me where the EURUSD currently stands after a trading day, sometimes I cannot tell them. Many traders often assume that round price levels are responsible for a trend reversal. In fact, there are still many institutional traders who hold on to round price levels, but they do not have the capital to significantly move the EURUSD. Here we see examples of round price levels in the EURUSD weekly chart. The fewest turning points take place in round price levels. In the current Euro FX contract, I took the trouble to sort the volume by price. Let's now see whether the main volume between 1.21 and 1.17 is actually always at round price levels. We are now looking at the largest volume mountains and see that these are not round price levels. Even the largest volume in this period did not take place at a round price level. Of course there are also price levels like 1.19 where this works, but there are more price levels where it doesn't work. In my opinion, making a trading decision from this would not be effective.

This is exactly why I developed the Bionic candle, it shows me the strongest movements in the chart. From this I can develop my key candles that show me the exact turning points. You can find more information about this in my videos. It is not the news but the market participants that influence the market. Why is that? Because we never know how market participants will react to news. And that's exactly why the market makes the news and not the other way around. Why is Apple stock falling after Apple has released sensational quarterly results? Possibly because investors believe Apple won't be able to recreate such gains in the next quarter to beat the stock's high. Whatever the reasons, we'll never know. In the evenings, the news channels are always fun to find out why the DAX or the EURUSD have risen or fallen. The reasons that are partly given for this are absolutely ridiculous and have nothing to do with reality. It doesn't matter what news goes on the ticker, the market is moving as people and computers push your head to buy or sell. And why do some traders buy while others sell? Well, because they have an opinion, and that opinion often has nothing to do with economic data.

And if you've lost money again, cheer up, dear investors. Business is 50% psychology, and the facts shouldn't be overstated. As we can see in the table, news is important and crucial for most traders. The HFT are an exception here, as they use the algorithms to scan the markets. News is also crucial for big players, after all, you pay their analysts well for it. However, they have a decisive advantage in this, they usually know in advance which results will be announced. Imagine that the big player collects a large number of asks in an accumulation phase. Suddenly an important economic news comes in, which speaks for a euro weakness and a dollar strength at the same time. That should actually push the course down. But what happens instead? The big player wants to bring his collected ask into a profit and will push the course up massively. Afterwards, the press writes that the euro has recovered. Of course, the economy in the individual countries is important, but not for me. How investors react to the news is far more important. Of course, the big players concentrate on market data and currency strength. However, we must never forget that it is the big players who determine with their strategies where the market is going. And that's exactly why I focus exclusively on the big players.

All I have to do is know where the euro or dollar is being bought or sold. And that's exactly why news is less relevant to me. So let's forget about the news and focus exclusively on the strategies of the big players. The big players' footprints are the big absorption packages from Bid and Ask. This is exactly what we have to identify, interpret and develop our strategies from. There is one small exception and that is the weekend. A lot of messages accumulate in these 48 hours. Since there is no market and therefore no price positions at this time, it is impossible to determine how these news will affect the price. At the beginning of the week there is therefore often a wait and see attitude to see how the market reacts to the past weekend. For me, however, what matters is when important economic data is due and how the big players react to it. Of course, I also pay attention to the crucial news in the market, but only to identify the peaks with high volatility. Big players often use this volatility to turn their collected ask or bid into a profit. If you have correctly recognized the collection campaign beforehand, you can use it to negotiate the decisive breakouts. At Forex Factory you get the crucial indicators that show you all upcoming news and even project them into your chart. So if you could identify beforehand whether it is an accumulation or distribution, you can trade this news because you know exactly in advance where the course is going. If the situation is unclear to you, I recommend not to act during this time.

Let's draw a conclusion:

Depending on your approach and strategy, you may be able to forego the price and news. This could potentially save you a lot of time in the future. The market in EURUSD moves because the big players collect in certain phases and then bring their ask or bid into a profit. If you are able to pinpoint this course of action, it will be easier for you to forego the price or the news. Whether this is possible always depends on your individual strategy and of course on the ASSETS in which you are trading.

There is also another important point and that is your personal marginal utility. Most traders lose money and it takes at least 6000 screen hours to break even. If a part-time trader trades 4 hours a day, that is over six years. The breake even zone is the hardest thing to achieve. The subsequent area of profit is then much easier to reach and then it is about optimization. The greatest marginal utility thus represents the breakeven point. Therefore, one should ask oneself what one needs the respective trading coach for? I recommend that you first determine your point of view and then define your goal.

First of all, you should deal with the question of what type of trader you belong to and in which area you feel comfortable. Then you should ask yourself what exactly do you need a coach for? Then comes the decision for group or individual training. And from that the decision whether a coach or a mentor would be the better choice. If you can answer all of these questions for yourself, you have made significant progress. In the next week I will show you how and where you can find a good coach or mentor, what costs you will incur and how you can protect yourself from unpleasant surprises.

You should do without these trading coaches

Hello dear subscribers,

the new video is online and, as always, you will first receive the English translation. You can find the link from the video at the end of my post.

In my last post we talked about the goals of coaching and mentoring and how to find out which type of coaching would be optimal. Today we talk about what to look for when looking for a coach or mentor and how to find the right trainer. In addition, you will receive a requirement profile that, in my opinion, a good and serious coach should meet. We also look at the costs and when coaching is actually worthwhile. Unfortunately, there is no Stiftung Warentest where you can compare the individual providers, so you are forced to listen to your inner voice. Most decisions are made emotionally, and many coaches use this situation to their advantage.

Before you can develop yourself further with the help of others, you first have to determine your own point of view and a possible goal, then the type of training and, at the end, the ideal training partner. Basically, we need to know that learning to trade takes either time or money. Let's start with the possibilities that cost time but not money. You can find a lot of good information on YouTube, I particularly recommend watching the videos from America. There you will get all the information you need. There are large trading forums for example Forex Factory or Future forums in America, where you can get excellent information. I myself created my own blog at Forex Factory over three years ago to write a trading diary, which enabled me to expand my knowledge incredibly and now I belong to the 5 best-known traders in Germany with almost 900,000 members. Over time, I developed my own strategies and got to know a lot of interesting traders. This communication resulted in friends with whom one exchanges regularly in order to initiate new ideas and projects. I also got to know very successful traders through my channel on YouTube who would never go public.

Now let's look at the options that cost money. Trading books also help to expand knowledge, although there you should refer to the recommendations of the readers. Trading videos are also available on the Udemy platform. For about 20 € you can get up to 20 hours of video material, but I can't make any statements about the quality because I used the platform for videos for programming. And they actually helped me. At the end there are still the trading coaches and mentors, which we are dealing with in more detail today. The biggest challenge lies in breaking even. A full-time trader needs an average of three years and a part-time trader at least six years. Most part-time traders want to be successful as soon as possible in order to be able to trade full-time. That's why you are ready to hire a trading coach. In fact, you can save a lot of time with a training coach, provided that the information is helpful to you. First of all, should you be clear about whether you need help in a specific area or whether you are ready to start from scratch? If you want to adopt a certain strategy from a coach, you may have to throw the knowledge you have learned overboard in order to absorb new knowledge. The question is, are you ready for this?

Let us first deal with the question of why a trader becomes a trading coach at all.

First, because he doesn't make any money trading.

Because he doesn't earn enough from training

Because he dreams of great wealth

Because he also needs a secure income

Because he wants to build up a second mainstay in addition to his training.

Because after ten years of training he is looking for further development

Because he wants to help others, but in this case he could also become a mentor.

Of course there are other different motivations why a trader becomes a coach, I definitely recommend finding a coach who does this because he wants to develop himself further or he wants to help others. However, the search is not that easy. There are over 500 different trading coaches in Germany, Austria and Switzerland, but the market is very limited as there are only 60,000 traders. For this reason, a coach has to offer something special that the others cannot. And that's why statements are often made here that are not entirely true. Imagine you are a lottery player and one day you discover a code to regularly hit the jackpot. You build yourself a small computer that you can use to generate your numbers on a regular basis. Honestly, would you sell this computer now or would you rather hit the jackpot yourself? If a trader had indeed found the holy grail, would they be willing to sell it? And it is precisely for this reason that a lot of information that you receive, from 90% of the coaches, is nothing more than mass-produced goods, which you can also obtain for free on the Internet.

Basically, I am not negative towards advertising, but certain advertising spots on YouTube really get on my nerves, I think you know do that too. Advertising is understood to be the dissemination of information to the public or to selected target groups by mostly profit-oriented companies with the purpose of making products and services known. In this example we see a funny commercial about Ceddar cheese, but it succeeded, and which you can watch over and over again. Why is a training coach ready to advertise for some € 100 or € 1000? Quite simply because it makes him more money than his own trading. And that's exactly what we should think hard about. To be honest, if a service or a product is offered somewhere at a sensationally low price, word gets around like wildfire and the item is sold out within a short time. If a coach is really good, word gets around very quickly because the traders are satisfied and then he doesn't have to advertise. And even if the trading coach has no customers, why doesn't he act himself during this time to finance his costs. After all, he shows other traders how to make money by trading. Then why does he even advertise?

As we all know, customer reviews on Amazon or eBay cannot always be trusted. The same applies to ratings in the service sector. I know many companies who offer their customers a discount when they write a positive recession. In the entire financial services sector, the average satisfaction rate in Germany is 75%. Interestingly, 362 trading coaches received an average rating of 90%. A rogue who thinks evil.

How do you recognize a serious trading coach?

He does little or no advertising on YouTube
Shows you some live trades in the forex market
Is ready to give in-depth, free tips
Does not sell a mass product that everyone can use
Develops your own creative approaches
He don t put monetary things in the foreground
Helps you reach your breakeven point
Provides you with his personal setup
Helps you assemble your workstation
Knows exactly how the market works
Is familiar with hardware and software
Carries out individual coaching or a maximum of 3-5 people
Can explain how the big players work
Knows examples of the use of algorithms
He avoid classic volume trading
Addresses your strengths and weaknesses individually
He works with forex and stock market data
Can figure out the most effective asset for you
He know, that there are no patterns in the price or chart
Knows the pip value per minute
He don t make long-term price forecasts
Does not sell trading signals or indicators

Imagine you are a doctor and you have your waiting room full of patients. You call on everyone who has a cold and carry out a uniform mass treatment. I think we all agree that no doctor in the world would do that. Of course, a doctor could earn more money with it, but every patient is unique and deserves individual treatment. A trader is also unique and individual, why should he get involved in group training?

In addition, I recommend that you avoid coaches who ...

... put yourself under time pressure
... who tell you how easy trading is.
... that promise you that you will earn a lot of money
... which reduce their trading products
... who are talking about a special offer
... which have their place of jurisdiction abroad
... who do massive advertising
... who flaunt money, real estate or cars
... who want to change you completely
...who make their competition bad
And the most important point
... he don't seem honest to you

A good trading coach ...

... helps you to understand the market.
... shows you where the big players buy and sell.
... helps you with time management as a part-time and full-time professional
... supports you in the selection of assets
... helps you in the area of hardware and software
... has a clear procedure
... is fundamentally familiar with tax and finance law
... helps you with money management and risk analysis
... knows the difference between cause and effect indicators
... knows how to use the native and synthetic iceberg orders
... can explain DoM, time and sales, heatmap and spoofing to you in detail
... gives you psychological support through his own life experience
... helps you with your trading evaluation / analysis
... provides you with his personal setup

If we think about it for a moment when we buy a new vehicle, how do we proceed? First we select different vehicles, look at various test reports on the Internet, then make personal phone calls with dealers, take a test drive, then make a decision and conduct individual negotiations again before we conclude the sales contract. This is exactly how we should proceed when choosing a trading coach. When you have made a selection of five or six different trading coaches, you should have a personal phone call. If the coach does not have time for you and someone other on the phone makes the call, I recommend you leave it. The mass treatment already stats here.

There are four key factors in trading. We start with the hard skills. This means the basic trading knowledge, strategies and procedures. Next, soft skills are a crucial factor. This means the methodical competence that supports our hard skills. Then there is psychology and self-reflection. The third shamrock is the hardware. This includes the complete composition of the workstation including sound and screens. Another point that should not be neglected is the software. This includes setting up the trading screen, reading out data and filtering the evaluation software. As a rule, the subject of hard skills is dealt with well in the training, there are deficiencies in the soft skills of the hardware and software. Now some will say that a trader does not have to be familiar with the hardware and software, but here I have to partly disagree. A pilot also has to deal with his aircraft, which is particularly noticeable during the PreFlight Check when he inspects his aircraft before take-off. A trader who is familiar with his technique often has a decisive advantage.

Let's come to the cost of a trading seminar. The prices vary massively between 3500 € -20,000 €. From time to time, high trading costs are compared with the pilot's license, which costs 70,000 € and is also an investment in the future. Let us take a closer look at this argument. The training to become a pilot takes two years; moreover, Lufthansa bears a large part of these costs provided that the pilot continues to work for Lufthansa afterwards. The training time is 3400 hours. That is an average cost of € 20 per hour for a commercial aircraft pilot's license. Incidentally, the starting salary of a pilot is € 5000 gross per month. That is an hourly wage of 30 euros. Let us now consider a training offer of 5000 euros for an annual training in which 20 people are involved. 30 videos, a three-day seminar and 30 Skype conferences with all 20 participants are made available. That is a total of 84 hours for the coach. The participant pays € 60 per hour, if we exclude the videos, it is € 100 per hour. However, for general group training. The training coach gets an hourly wage of € 1,850. From my point of view, this is not only outrageous, but a complete rip-off.

What I would find absolutely fine would be if a participant could get 50 individual Skype lessons for 5000 €. In this way the trainer could adjust to the individual participant and I am convinced that the chances of success would be 1000 times greater. If the coach is hardworking, he could individually train four participants in 200 hours and would still earn enough money with it. From my point of view, the dream of getting rich on the stock exchange is being exploited here to call up outrageous prices. Therefore I believe that there are fewer and fewer people who are willing to pay these prices in the future. The first coaches have already noticed this, as the number of their participants is falling dramatically. What I do not understand is that the trading participant pays without making claims. The customer is king and not the coach. But many traders hope for a successful entry into the million dollar market of the stock exchange.

Don't just let the money be pulled out of your pocket and compare the price-performance ratio. I know it's difficult, but I would always value a individual coaching.

Invest a maximum of 20-40% of your risk capital, at 5000 € this is a maximum of 2000 € for coaching.

For this I would expect individual coaching of at least 20 hours.

Joint live training in the largest market in the world

Forget the videos, you can also get the information on the Internet

And let you explain how the big players work

In addition, the coach should address your strengths and weaknesses individually.

The coach and the training participant should always work according to the WIN WIN principle, a business is good, when both are satisfied. Most of the time it's just the coach. If you cannot find a suitable trading coach who meets your requirements, you should look for a suitable mentor. Konrad Adenauer was the mentor of Helmut Kohl and Helmut Kohl was the mentor of Angela Merkel. You can say what you want about the party, but these three politicians still enjoy an excellent reputation around the world. And the previous and intensive mentoring was essentially responsible for this. As we know, mentoring is relationship-oriented, long-term and therefore development-oriented. From my point of view in the trading area the best approach. Let's take another quick look at the part-time trader who typically takes six years to break even. Let's assume that this trader only finds his personal mentor after two years. With the help, he is able to break even two years later and has saved two years.

First, let's look at how it would go without a mentor. In the first six years a loss of € 12,000 is achieved. From the seventh year he is in the breakeven area and after that he makes profits. After ten years he is easily profitable and has good chances for the next few years. Since the trader only finds his mentor after two years, he naturally makes the same loss for the first two years. With the help of the mentor, the loss is reduced to 1000 euros and in the fifth year he already reaches the breakeven point. The following years are then much more positive; in the overall result, that could well be an advantage of € 54,000 in ten years. But let's first look at the short-term area. That would be a benefit of € 8,000 within six years. The question is, how much are you willing to invest? The idea that the coach only earns money if the trader earn money on the stock market would also be interesting. The industry would probably die out as a result. Of course, every trader wants to become successful as quickly as possible, but the stock market is so complex that the clocks tick differently here. The most important quality of a trader should be patience. A blade of grass doesn't grow any faster if you pull on it. So there is strength in rest.

In my opinion, a good trading coach or mentor is just as difficult to find as the right life partner. And I don't need to tell anyone how often we have made the wrong decision in this area. The exchange opens every Monday and closes on Friday, there is no need to rush. Take your time to find the right trading partner, everything else will only cost you unnecessary time and a lot of money. Still 88% of all traders lose their money. You shouldn't belong.

Plan the trading efficiency with my new Excel spreadsheet

Hello dear subscribers,

the new video is online and, as always, you will first receive the English translation. You can find the link from the video at the end of my post.

In trading, there are no reliable price forecasts or strategies that show us the future price development. And yet there is a great ally and that is the probability. In addition, there are factors such as CRV, pip value / min, the range between profit and loss and the expected value. Bringing all these things under one roof is a great challenge. For this purpose I have created a special Excel table for you today, with which you can see all these things at the same time. I'll show you examples of how you can double your income with small changes without increasing your risk. First take a look at the video, at the end you can download the table for free from my blog. In my video on how we can effectively reduce the trading tax in 2021, I have already discussed the deductibility of future trading losses in more detail. In addition, different alternatives were examined to reduce the trading tax. Let us look again at the text of the law. Cumulative profit transactions with futures can be deducted up to € 20,000 per year. The remainder is carried forward indefinitely and can be used up to € 20,000 in the following year if there is still a profit that can be offset within the year. That is also logical, because a loss carryforward can only ever be offset against newly generated profit.

In 2021 a trader will make a profit of € 72,000 and a loss of € 40,000. Since he can offset a maximum of € 20,000 in losses in this year, there is a loss carryforward for 2022. If he achieves the same profits and losses in 2022, the loss carried forward from 2021 and the loss from 2022 will now come into effect. Now let's look at how I interpret the new tax legislation. In 2021, € 72,000 in profits will be made, € 40,000 in losses and a maximum of € 20,000 deductible. There was no loss carryforward from last year, as the law was only introduced in 2021. This means that € 52,000 is taxed and a tax of € 13,712 is due without church tax. In the next year, the same profits and losses arise, € 20,000 are deductible and the loss carryforward from last year is also added. The tax is € 32,000, which results in a tax amount of € 8,438. If profits and losses remained the same, the tax amount would remain at € 8,438. In four years that would be a tax amount of € 39,000. Before the tax reform, the trader would have paid € 5,000 less. I would like to make an important statement at this point. I am exclusively a private trader and transmit the trader tax information as I understand it in the legal text. This can lead to errors of interpretation at any time, I am not liable for you. For this reason, I recommend that each of you always discuss your individual situation with a tax lawyer, tax advisor or auditor.

Let's look at key factors in trading that I'm going to discuss in more detail today. A trader only reaches his breakeven point if he takes these factors into account and combines them with one another. The greatest challenge lies in linking these factors. For this I have built a tool for you that will support you. There are also four other factors that I have developed: pip value per minute, dollars per minute, the range between profit and loss and the tax value. There are many ways to evaluate your trades, today I would like to introduce you to my approach. First of all, I need the time when I entered the trade, the trade direction, the currency pair and the entry price. Then I need the exit time, the exit price, the number of lots, the spread, the stop size, how many seconds the trade ran and the result of the pip. From this I can calculate the pip value per minute, the profit achieved, the profit that would result from it per minute, the CRV as well as my individual grading. Now the individual trades are continued in the same way. A little tip on the side: I always record my trades with a video program in order to check them more closely afterwards. Let's briefly analyze these 18 trades.

On average, I was in the market with 2.4 lots, the spread was 0.6 and the stop was 1.4 pip. A trade lasted an average of 30 seconds, including losses of 1.5 pips with a pip value of 5.2 per minute. The expected value was $ 31 and the potential was even $ 120. With a win rate of 83%, a CRV of 1.1 was achieved. My average rating was 2. Next, the trades were sorted into long and short. The profit rate for the long trades was 90% while I only got 75% for the short trades. With the long trades, I made more overall, but on average only $ 32 per trade, while I got an average of $ 67 with the schort trades. There are already very good evaluation tools in MT4, and you can also use other offers on the Internet. Due to the inadequate data security for me, I only analyze my data offline, especially since the pip value per minute is also not available online.

Let's take a quick look at the pip value per minute and why it is so important to me. We see an upward movement in the M1 here. 20 pips were achieved within 30 minutes, that is 0.66 pips per minute. After that, the course went back and reached exactly my key candle. You will find that this key candle was the strongest candle in the upward movement. You can get more information about this in my videos. The downward movement occurred within 4 minutes, reaching 18 pips. That's 4.5 pips per minute. On the up move I had to risk my money for 30 minutes while the down move only lasted 4 minutes. The average of the up and down movement was 38 pips in 34 minutes. That's an average of 1.2 pips per minute. So if the average risk is 1.2 pips per minute, movements smaller than 1.2 pips automatically represent a higher risk. Movements greater than 1.2 pip per minute, on the other hand, represent a lower risk. Viewed from the average, the upward movement was 100% riskier, while the downward movement compared to the average represented a 3.5 times lower risk. Overall, the downward movement was 6.8 times faster than the upward movement and thus the risk was 6.8 times smaller. We recognize: the risk and the pip value per minute are always contrary to each other. For this reason I always try to achieve a higher pip value than the average in order to minimize my risk. In my long trades, the average pip value was 3.6 and only 77% of all winning trades exceeded the average of 1.5 pip per minute. In my short trades, the average pip value was 7.2 and 100% of all winning trades exceeded the average of 1.5 pip per minute. So the downward movements for the pip value per minute represent a great potential. You can find more information about this in my videos

Before a trader becomes profitable, he needs a good strategy and an auxiliary tool with which he can analyze his strategy and money management. I have developed a new tool for you in Excel that you can of course get for free. Let's take a look at the tool first. The input tool is on the left, where 9 different inputs have to be made. We start with the capital on the broker account, the leverage, the number of lots that are traded, the average profit rate, the spread, the stop, the TP, the number of your trades per year and the tax rate. In the basic setting, capital gains tax including the solidarity surcharge is calculated; church tax is not taken into account here. After your entry you will see the tax limit of 833. That means after 833 trades you have reached the tax limit of 20,000 €.

The maximum pre-tax profit of $ 10,000 applies to the 833 trades. Now the calculation bar follows, where the spread, the stop, the TP and the profit and loss ratio are shown again. There are around 5 million retail traders worldwide, 90% of whom lose every month. That's a shockingly high number and at first glance you can't believe that such a high rate of loss is possible. In today's post we want to look at why this is in detail. In the videos I have produced so far, you will find good solutions that can help you in the future. We can gloss it over as we want. The fact is that only 5% of all traders make long-term profits. 5% are breakeven and 90% suffer losses. The dramatic thing is that the 5% who make profits unfortunately not all traders can make a living from it. The fundamental question is what reason should there be for you, of all people, to be one of the winners in the future. Maybe some of my approaches will help you, if so I would be very happy about it.

One of the main reasons so many traders lose is the fact that many believe that the stock market is very simple. Accordingly, they meet the big players in the market. Playing chess is also relatively easy in principle, but not when you play against the world champion. And in the stock market we compete against the best traders in the world every day. It would be presumptuous to believe that you have a fair chance here. This does not mean that it is impossible to trade profitably, but one should enter the markets with the necessary respect. Another problem is working with the indicators. Many traders rely on indicators to make the decision as to whether or not to enter a trade. And that is exactly a big mistake that can cost a lot of money in the long term. Here we should always pay attention to the causality principle of cause and effect. Only the market orders that run into the limit orders are responsible for a price change and not the indicator that suddenly indicates an oversold. From this cause the effect arises, like the price the candles and the time. Trading decisions should never be made on the basis of an effect, but always on the basis of the cause itself.

A lot of traders pay too much attention to the price from my point of view. Of course, a price randomly changes direction at an even price level, but as a rule you will not notice that. As we know, there is actually no above and below in the price, so the price is completely irrelevant to me. In most cases I don't even know exactly where the price is in EURUSD. In EURUSD, the average cost per lot is ten dollars. If I do ten trades, the broker has already made $ 100. With a 60% win rate, I have to win at least $ 16 per trade to make as much as my broker. This $ 100 that the broker earns logically reduces my profit. In addition to the costs and fees, the execution times and many other things are of course also important. You can find detailed information about this in my videos.

The hype about volume trading began ten years ago in Germany, although volume trading is nothing new as the big players have been working with it for over 30 years. However, the big players do not work with volume in the way many coaches portray it. The volume is just an addition of the ask and bid. Interestingly enough, ask and bid never meet and have nothing to do with each other in the market. In the high volume peaks, people like to talk about the fair price, but the fair price is where there was hardly any volume. For this reason, volume trading is ineffective for me. Many traders look to the news to make trading decisions. But it is not the news that influences the market, it is the market that influences the news. Check out my last video about this. There I'll show you that not even the latest news from the FED have a significant impact on the markets (except for volatility). The big players who have previously collected ask or bids in certain price regions determine where the markets will go.

It is also a mistake to assume that there are both upward and downward trends. What we see on the chart are only movements that are initiated by the big players. These movements are only dependent on the reactions of the 1 million retail traders. For this reason, the market technique and the candle formation are ineffective for me. Every day, many traders look for the ASSETS with the highest volatility in different markets, because they believe they can make a profit with it. Basically, this line of thought is not wrong, but 90% of traders lose their money. High volatility is therefore rather counterproductive for over 90% of traders, as they lose money even faster with this approach. The Apple share has a significantly higher volatility than the EURUSD, which is due to the fact that the largest big players in the world provide a massive amount of liquidity in the EURUSD. That is precisely where security is significantly higher. Another challenge is the flood of information from the stock exchanges, which runs exclusively through our brain canal, seeing. Our eyes are totally overloaded in trading, as they can only absorb about 25 pieces of information per second. For this reason, I work with tones that our brain can pick up up to 20 times more efficiently. This often brings significant market advantages.

Many future traders often only concentrate on the market orders, although it is primarily the limit orders that influence the market. In addition, I made a nice comparison with a vehicle in my videos to show the dominance of limit orders. In order to anticipate the short-term market development one has to be able to identify a kind of 3-D strength in the limit and market orders. This results in further advantages. Another challenge is that every trader has different skills and approaches. You can't lump traders together. First of all, you should find out whether you are suitable as a swing trader, day trader or scalper. When this question has been answered, you should create and further optimize your individual setup precisely in this area. A trader who tries to be able to do everything is in the end just a duck who can do everything. Flies swim, run and dive, but in no area does it stand a chance against its competition.

In EURUSD, downward movements are 30-40% faster than upward movements. Those who use this information to their advantage can earn up to 30% more without changing their strategy. Anyone who wants to become successful as a trader must inevitably deal with these decisive factors in trading. This is about efficient money management that can only be achieved if in-depth information is available. From this information you can identify your strengths and weaknesses as well as your mistakes and improve them in the long term. A greatly underestimated factor in trading is the amount of screen time spent trading. This screen time is essentially responsible for when you hit your personal breakeven point. It's like playing a video game, the more you play the better you get. It is therefore crucial not to invest so much money in the beginning. A crucial point why so many traders lose is due to the fact that they have simply chosen the wrong asset for themselves. In my videos you will find a table where you can calculate your optimal asset. In the example you can see that personally I am four times faster in profit in EURUSD than in pound US dollars. I can also urge every trader to take a closer look at currency strengths. Use time and volume-independent charts for this. The best information can be generated from this and it can even be used to read out algorithms. Since we are dealing more and more with algorithms in this market, you will have to deal with them in the future. Get creative and develop your own strategies and procedures to penetrate even deeper into the market. This results in further market advantages. It is a great fairy tale that you have a real chance against the big players with a laptop. No big player works with a laptop, but with state-of-the-art technology and the fastest servers in the world, which are located as close as possible to the stock exchange locations. Our technology today ages very quickly, as you can see in the following article. Not only does our knowledge double every ten years, technology and progress are also changing our language rapidly. Another reason why so many traders lose is that over 70% of the price trend takes place in the equilibrium or sideways market. This is exactly where small price movements occur, which make it so difficult for day or swing traders. Basically, the stock market is by far the largest market in the world. Strategy, part-time to become a successful trader

Hello dear subscribers,

the new video is online and, as always, you will first receive the English translation. You can find the link from the video at the end of my post.

Many people dream of becoming a successful trader. But what's the smartest way to do it? Do I jump into the deep end and start full-time straight away, or is there a good alternative that offers me the security I need and that may bring me to profitability in 3 years. In addition, I will give you some important information that will significantly increase your probability of winning. For this purpose I analyzed some 100,000 candles, the result is very interesting and will help you in the trade. In Germany there are 44.7 million gainfully employed persons, of which 40.7 million are salaried and over 4 million self-employed. Of the 40.7 million employees, over 3 million also have a part-time job, as the income from one job is no longer sufficient for many employees. 23% are very satisfied in their job, 55% are moderately satisfied and 22% are dissatisfied. Since the self-employed and part-time workers can usually choose their activities, this satisfaction relates to the remaining 37 million employees. The fact that 55% are only moderately satisfied shows that there are massive problems here too.

There are many reasons for dissatisfaction. Too much work, too little time, too little money, and annoying colleagues are criticized by most. There is a lack of recognition in the job, self-realization is seldom given, there is little prospect for the future and the question of meaning is judged poorly by most. The time dependency, work from 7 a.m. to 4 p.m. and the local dependency are also criticized. Long driving times to work are not counted as working time. The job is performed according to regulations and wrong values are conveyed in the process. Many criticize the loneliness at work, such as parcel delivery staff or agents, and feel that they are underutilized. Not only is working with hazardous substances harmful to health, but also sitting in open-plan offices with poor ventilation. Overall, many do not have a work-life balance. Many trading coaches who advertise on YouTube take advantage of employee dissatisfaction. From her point of view, trading is associated with: Little work, more time, a lot of money and great colleagues. There is recognition you can realize yourself has a future perspective and the question of meaning has also been clarified. You can work when and where you want and determine your own values. Joint trading in a team, there is no underchallenge, lots of breaks and the work-life balance is not neglected either. Some trading coaches even recommend jumping into the deep end. You should simply book a seminar with them and then quit your job and immediately start full-time as a successful trader. I can only urgently warn you not to comply with this request. Because these trading coaches are primarily concerned with the money that they earn from you.

In truth, as a trading beginner you have a lot of work, little time and no money because you only lose at the beginning. There are hardly any colleagues who act in the same setup as you. You will only receive recognition from the trading coach if you pay for it. Of course you can self-actualize, while your wife goes to work and earns money, you lose your money on the stock market. Of course, you do not have great future prospects in trading at the beginning and you can clarify the question of meaning when you have become successful. You can work whenever you want, but in the beginning I worked 13-14 hours a day and even on weekends. Of course, you no longer have to drive to work every morning and do the work according to the rules, but now you have to observe your own rules and values. You will continue to trade alone all day, you will be overwhelmed by the approach of the big players and if you forget to take breaks, your health and your work-life balance will suffer. When you suddenly become self-employed as a former employee, there are many challenges. I know that exactly because I've been self-employed for over 32 years and I made a lot of mistakes at the beginning.

If you do a mini job for three years, you have to work 1500 hours and earn € 16,000. In trading, you will invest at least 3,000 hours in the first three years and possibly lose € 12,000 or even more. Of course you have to invest as an entrepreneur, the question is always whether you can afford it. I don't know if your life partner will love it. The fact is you invest a lot of time in the beginning, have less time for the family, and are stressed when things don't go well. You lose money for the first three years and have little support in trading and possibly at home. But there is a solution to this, and that's what we're going to talk about today. How do you learn to ride a bike? It is best to start with a balance bike, where the sense of balance is best trained. And once you master this skill, you can start with a small bike. That's why I would recommend most of you to start trading on a part-time basis and as soon as you have made steady profits, you can switch to a main job. Of course, it depends on your individual situation, if you are single and have no responsibility for a family, you are of course more free in your decision. Of course, full-time trading is the most efficient, but today I'm going to show you a way how you can achieve your goals faster in part-time trading.

Since trading is all about probabilities, we have to deal with it first. Let's consider an Risk-reward ratio  1. Our stop is five pips from the entry and so is the TP. This would result in a profit probability of 50%, of course without spread and commission. These costs further reduce our probability of winning. A RRR of 2 reduces our chance of winning to 33% and a RRR of 3 only gives us a 25% chance of winning. A RRR of 4 means we lose 80% of the time and a RRR of 5 means we have a 17% chance of winning. The pure RRR consideration is of no use to us, the decisive factor is our personal profit ratio. Let's take a look at which RRR the most successful traders work with. Goldman Sachs has a hit rate of 90% with a RRR of just over 2, even though they are primarily day traders.

The range in which a part-time trader acts is a decisive criterion. To do this, we look at the EURUSD in the M5 in the time from 5 p.m. to 8 p.m., where a part-time trader can trade. To get a RRR of 3, we use a stop of 5 pips and a TP of 15 pips. The graph for the short and long trades can be seen on the right. We are now placing this graphical representation next to the range. Which trading is actually suitable for a part-time professional, is it swing trading, day trading or scalping? The first challenge is that the part-time trader can only start trading at 4 or 5 p.m. to trade for a maximum of 2-3 hours. As a scalper you work with small stops, use larger stakes to achieve a small pip target with significantly more trades at the same time. This means that if the pip value per minute is below the ATR, the greater my risk automatically becomes. Now many will think well after 1 minute he have reached two pips, but four pips after 6 minutes is twice as much. Hello dear subscribers,

The breakeven point is the most important factor as only 10% of all traders reach it. This breakeven point can be reached within 6000 hours or 6000 trades with certain conditions. Since a trader only loses at the beginning from the perspective of probability, he should first concentrate on limiting losses. He achieves this with a small number of lot and small stops. Once he has reached his breakeven point, he can focus on maximizing his profits by scaling. In practice, it usually works the other way around. A mathematical law also helps us with this. The law of large numbers is a limit theorem from probability that helps us in trading. In the simplest case, it describes that the relative frequency of a random event approaches the theoretical probability of this event if the random experiment is only carried out often enough. This means that we can use the sample mean to estimate the expected value of random variables well. The following applies: the larger the sample size, the more precise our expected value becomes. A large sample is therefore an important requirement so that you can make reliable estimates about your future expected value. And now I'll show you how we can increase the number of our trades.

Here we see an M1 chart in EURUSD with different zigzag lines within 80 minutes. A day trader, indicated by the red line, can trade two movements during this time. A minute scalper can do 16 movements and a seconds scalper can do 34 movements. What is the difference between a minute and a seconds scalper? The seconds scalper can also be in the market for a few minutes, but usually ends its trades earlier than the minute scalper. This means that in this example, a day trader has an entry opportunity every 40 minutes on average, the minute scalper every five minutes and the seconds scalper after 2.5 minutes, which results in the seconds scalper 48 chances within 2 hours and even 96 entry chances in 4 hours.
